_meta.role: Bridge File - connects the ML taxonomy (Domain -> Issue) to legal truth (Act -> Section). Holds issue prototype texts (Module 2) and issue-to-provision references (Module 3).
_meta.population_status: COMPREHENSIVELY POPULATED - 143 verified realistic legal situations across all 5 domains.
governance: CLAUDE.md Section 6.3-6.4 (prototypes are Module 2's similarity corpus), 6.7 Layer B (provision_relevance_rationale is human-curated), 7.3 (reference integrity).
Reference integrity: every (act_id, section_id) pair resolves to a real entry in acts_and_sections.json.
All prototype texts use realistic citizen-voice scenarios without legal jargon.

otp_fraud.issue_definition: Citizen was manipulated into sharing an OTP or banking credential by an impersonator, followed by unauthorized fund transfer.
prototype_texts: Someone called me pretending to be from my bank and asked for the OTP that came on my phone, and after I told them money was taken from my account.
A caller claiming to be from bank or wallet customer support tricked me into sharing an OTP or PIN and an unauthorized transaction happened right after that.
I received a phone call about KYC verification or card blocking, the person asked me to read out the code sent by SMS, and then money got debited from my account without my permission.
A fraudster acting like customer care of a payment app made me share a verification code on call and immediately transferred money out of my wallet or account.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies because the offender extracted and dishonestly used the citizen's unique electronic authentication credential (OTP).
Applies because the offender cheated by impersonating bank personnel using a communication device.

online_impersonation.issue_definition: Someone poses online or via digital channels as a real person, acquaintance, official, or company using fake profiles or spoofed identities to deceive or defraud.
prototype_texts: Someone has created a fake social media profile using my name and photos and is contacting people I know to ask them for money.
A person called claiming to be a police officer or government official and threatened action against my family member unless money was paid to settle a case.
Somebody is pretending to be my employer or a senior person on a messaging app and instructing colleagues to make urgent purchases or money transfers.
A fake profile pretending to be a real company or a known person deceived me during online conversations and took money from me under false pretences.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating another person, official, or organization using computer resources.
Applies when identity features like photos, names, or electronic credentials are misappropriated.

phishing.issue_definition: Citizen received deceptive links, emails, SMS messages, or websites engineered to harvest passwords, banking credentials, or payments.
prototype_texts: I got an SMS or email with a link that opened a page looking exactly like my bank or a government website and it asked me to enter my card details or login password.
A message said my electricity or phone bill was unpaid and gave a link to pay immediately, but the link took my banking details and deducted money instead.
I clicked on a link received on WhatsApp promising a free reward or subsidy, and it directed me to a fake portal that captured my UPI credentials.
An email pretending to be from my income tax department asked me to update refund details on a cloned webpage where my credentials were stolen.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to fraudulent harvesting and unauthorized use of login passwords and financial credentials through deceptive electronic forms.
Applies to cheating by personating authentic organizations, banks, or utilities through cloned websites and phishing links.

identity_theft.display_name: Identity Theft / Misuse of Personal Identifiers
identity_theft.issue_definition: Unauthorized use of personal identity identifiers (Aadhaar, PAN, voter ID, biometrics) to open accounts, take loans, or obtain mobile connections.
prototype_texts: I found out that an unknown person has taken a loan or opened a credit card using my PAN card and Aadhaar details without my knowledge.
Multiple mobile numbers have been registered in my name using my identity documents without my consent.
Someone used my Aadhaar number or forged documents to open an unauthorized bank account that is now being used for fraud.
My identity documents were compromised online and are being used by fraudsters to impersonate me and obtain financial services.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Primary statutory provision penalizing fraudulent or dishonest misuse of unique identity features, Aadhaar, PAN, or electronic signatures of another person.

unauthorized_account_access.issue_definition: An intruder gained unauthorized access into citizen's email, social media, crypto wallet, or digital account, altering credentials or misusing data.
prototype_texts: My email account was hacked and the password and recovery phone number were changed so I can no longer access it.
Someone broke into my social media account, locked me out, and is posting unauthorized messages or contacting my friends.
An unknown device accessed my online shopping or gaming account and made unauthorized transactions using saved cards.
My personal cloud storage account was breached and private documents and photos were accessed without my permission.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Provides civil compensation against any person accessing computer resources, accounts, or databases without permission.
Criminalizes unauthorized access, hacking, and password altering of computer accounts when committed dishonestly or fraudulently.

other_online_financial_fraud.display_name: Other Online Financial Fraud / Fake Schemes
other_online_financial_fraud.issue_definition: Deceptive online investment schemes, fake crypto trading applications, or unregulated deposit schemes promising unrealistic returns.
prototype_texts: I invested money in an online trading app that promised guaranteed high daily returns, but now the platform has shut down and will not let me withdraw.
A group on Telegram invited me to invest in a cryptocurrency scheme promising 300% returns, but after depositing funds the admin blocked me.
I was induced to deposit money into an online high-yield investment scheme that turned out to be an unregulated Ponzi fraud.
A fake stock market advisory portal took subscription money and investment capital promising insider tips and disappeared.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating and extracting funds using digital communication and fraudulent online investment interfaces.
Statutory prohibition completely banning unregulated deposit schemes and unauthorized investment solicitation.

sim_swap_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudsters obtained a duplicate SIM card in citizen's mobile number, deactivating citizen's SIM and intercepting 2FA banking codes.
prototype_texts: My phone suddenly lost network signal and when I checked with my telecom provider, they said a duplicate SIM card had been issued in my name, followed by money stolen from my bank.
Fraudsters executed a SIM swap on my mobile number without my authorization and used the intercepted OTPs to empty my savings account.
My mobile SIM card was deactivated without my request and an unauthorized replacement SIM was issued to a stranger who accessed my banking apps.
I experienced an unexpected network blackout on my mobile phone, during which unauthorized banking transactions occurred via intercepted SMS verification codes.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies because unauthorized SIM replacement impairs and diminishes the utility of the citizen's mobile network connection and device access.
Applies to the dishonest acquisition and misuse of the subscriber identity credential to extract two-factor authentication codes.

remote_access_app_fraud.display_name: Remote Access App Fraud (Customer Care Scam)
remote_access_app_fraud.issue_definition: Citizen was deceived into installing screen-sharing software (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, QuickSupport) by callers posing as support staff.
prototype_texts: A caller pretending to be customer support told me to install AnyDesk or TeamViewer to fix a refund problem, and then they saw my screen and stole money.
I was asked to download a quick support app by someone claiming to be from courier or bank customer care, and they took control of my phone and transferred funds.
Under the pretext of resolving a failed transaction, a fake executive guided me to install a screen-sharing app and viewed my UPI PIN while I typed it.
A fraudster claiming to help me with technical support made me install a remote monitoring tool and executed unauthorized transactions while viewing my display.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to securing unauthorized access to the victim's mobile device or computer through deceitful installation of screen-monitoring tools.
Applies to cheating by personating official customer support staff using digital voice communication and remote management software.

loan_app_fraud.issue_definition: Predatory digital lending applications that harvested user contacts, photos, and messages, followed by extortion, harassment, and morphed photo blackmail.
prototype_texts: I took a small loan from a mobile app that charged huge hidden fees and is now calling all my contacts and threatening to send morphed pictures if I don't pay more.
An instant loan app accessed my gallery and contacts without proper disclosure and is blackmailing my family members for unauthorized repayment.
Recovery agents from an illegal digital lending app are sending abusive WhatsApp messages to my contacts and circulating edited photos of me.
A quick cash loan app demanded immediate repayment of triple the borrowed amount and is harassing my phone contacts with defamatory messages.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to unauthorized downloading, copying, and extraction of personal contact books and gallery photos from the citizen's mobile device.
Applies to violation of privacy by intentionally capturing, morphing, and transmitting private personal images without consent.

sextortion_fraud.issue_definition: Citizen was lured into a video call or had personal media recorded/morphed, followed by extortion demands threatening to circulate explicit videos to contacts.
prototype_texts: I received a video call from an unknown person who stripped, and now they have recorded my face and are demanding money or they will send the video to my friends.
A blackmailer is threatening to upload compromising or morphed nude photos of me on social media and send them to my relatives unless I pay extortion money.
Someone contacted me on WhatsApp, recorded a private video call without my consent, and is threatening to leak it online if I do not pay.
I am being extorted by scammers who edited my face onto obscene pictures and are demanding ransom payments to prevent public distribution.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Primary statutory prohibition penalizing transmitting or threatening to publish obscene or sexually explicit material in electronic form.
Provides aggravated penal consequences for transmitting sexually explicit visual content or deepfake acts.
Applies to privacy violations involving unauthorized capture, dissemination, or morphing of intimate personal imagery.

qr_code_fraud.issue_definition: Citizen was manipulated into scanning a payment QR code or entering a UPI PIN under the fraudulent promise that scanning would credit money.
prototype_texts: I was selling furniture on OLX and the buyer sent me a QR code saying scan this to receive advance payment, but scanning it debited money from my account.
A person asked me to scan a barcode or QR code on Google Pay or PhonePe to collect prize money, but it deducted funds instead of crediting them.
I received a payment QR code with instructions to approve the request to accept a deposit, and as soon as I entered my UPI PIN, money was deducted.
A buyer on an online marketplace claimed they could only pay via QR code transfer and tricked me into approving a collect request that drained my wallet.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personation and deceptive manipulation using digital payment systems and computer resources.

digital_arrest_extortion.issue_definition: Fraudsters pose on video/audio calls as CBI, Police, Narcotics, or Customs officers, falsely accusing citizen of crimes and placing them under 'digital arrest' to extort money.
prototype_texts: Callers pretending to be Mumbai police and CBI showed me fake arrest warrants over Skype and made me stay on video call for hours while demanding money for clearance.
I received a call claiming a parcel containing illegal passports or narcotics was caught in my name, and fake officers placed me under digital arrest and forced me to transfer funds.
Scammers claiming to be from the Enforcement Directorate threatened me with immediate arrest on video call and coerced me into transferring my savings to a 'verification account'.
A fake police official on a WhatsApp video call wearing a uniform threatened me with criminal prosecution unless I paid bail money immediately to avoid arrest.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by impersonating law enforcement officers and government agencies over electronic communication devices to extort funds.

social_media_giveaway_fraud.issue_definition: Fake lotteries, lucky draw announcements, or celebrity giveaways on social media requiring payment of processing fees, taxes, or delivery charges before prize release.
prototype_texts: I received an Instagram message saying I won an expensive smartphone or car in a lucky draw, but I must pay customs duty and GST in advance to receive it.
A WhatsApp message claimed I won 25 lakh rupees in a KBC lottery and asked me to transfer processing fees to claim the cheque.
An online contest promised guaranteed luxury gifts but demanded registration charges and courier insurance, after which the organizers vanished.
I paid multiple fees for prize clearance and document processing for an online lottery I supposedly won, but never received any prize money.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personation and false pretences using computer resources to deceive citizens into paying fictitious processing fees.

part_time_job_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudsters lure the citizen into Telegram/WhatsApp groups promising daily earnings for completing simple tasks, then extort deposits for 'VIP tasks'.
prototype_texts: I was offered a work-from-home job liking YouTube videos and rating hotels on Telegram, but after paying small amounts they made me invest 2 lakhs for VIP tasks that I cannot withdraw.
A recruiter on WhatsApp offered me a part-time review job where initial small commissions were paid, but then they locked my money in a fake trading portal demanding more deposits to release it.
I joined an online task-based earning scheme where I had to complete merchant rating orders, and now the scammers refuse to refund my deposits unless I pay a 30% tax.
Fraudsters promised 3000 rupees daily for simple online rating tasks, lured me into depositing money for higher commission levels, and then blocked me from the group.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personation through communication networks and digital platforms under false job and employment pretences.
Applies because soliciting task-based deposits with promises of guaranteed returns constitutes a banned unregulated deposit scheme.

courier_customs_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudsters call impersonating courier companies (FedEx, DHL, India Post) or customs officials, claiming a parcel sent by or addressed to victim contains contraband.
prototype_texts: A recorded call claiming to be FedEx informed me that a parcel sent to Taiwan in my name containing 5 passports and illegal drugs was seized by Customs.
Someone posing as an India Post customs officer called saying my overseas parcel had illegal substances and connected me to a fake police department to extort clearance money.
I was told by a courier company executive on call that an international package containing contraband had my Aadhaar linked to it and I had to pay penalty fees immediately.
Scammers claiming to represent DHL Customs demanded penalty payments into a bank account to cancel an arrest warrant for an illegal parcel I never sent.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to fraudulent impersonation of courier services, customs authorities, and parcel delivery services over communication devices.

utility_disconnection_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudulent SMS messages threatening immediate disconnection of electricity, water, or gas services due to an unpaid bill, urging citizen to call an urgent number or download an APK.
prototype_texts: I received an urgent SMS saying electricity will be disconnected tonight by 9:30 PM due to unpaid bill, and when I called the given number they stole my money.
A message pretending to be from the state electricity board instructed me to call an officer immediately to update my power bill, and they made me install an app that debited my bank.
I got a text warning that my power connection was being terminated tonight and to pay 10 rupees via an APK link to update KYC, which resulted in unauthorized account deductions.
Fraudsters sent an alert claiming my water or gas supply would be cut off within hours unless I called a customer support helpline where they tricked me into sharing payment details.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating state utility electricity boards and municipal supply officials through SMS and communication devices.
Applies where citizens are deceived into downloading malicious APK files that compromise mobile device data and banking security.

matrimonial_romance_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudster establishes a fake emotional or romantic relationship on matrimonial sites or dating apps, deceiving victim into sending money for custom clearance of gifts or emergencies.
prototype_texts: A person I met on a matrimonial site claimed to be an NRI doctor who sent expensive jewelry for me that is stuck at Delhi airport customs, demanding clearance fees.
Someone on a dating app built a relationship with me over weeks and then asked for urgent financial assistance for a medical emergency abroad and vanished after payment.
A fake profile on a marriage portal induced me to send money for business investment and visa processing fees, after which the profile was deleted.
I was cheated by a stranger on a matrimonial platform who claimed they were detained by immigration authorities and needed immediate funds for release.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating a genuine matrimonial partner or NRI professional over computer resources and online dating platforms.

customer_care_spoofing.display_name: Spoofed Customer Care Number Search Fraud
customer_care_spoofing.issue_definition: Fraudsters place fake customer support telephone numbers on Google Maps or search results for banks, airlines, or couriers; when called, they extract financial details.
prototype_texts: I searched for my airline customer service number on Google, called the first number that appeared, and the fake executive tricked me into sharing card details for a refund.
I looked up the helpline number of a food delivery or courier company online, and the caller made me send money via UPI under the guise of an order cancellation fee.
A fake bank toll-free number listed on Google Search connected me to fraudsters who asked for my net banking password to resolve a failed transaction.
I dialed a customer support number found on Google Maps for a courier refund, and the operator instructed me to install a payment app that deducted funds.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating authentic corporate customer care executives using deceptive listings on search engines and communication channels.

card_cloning_skimming.issue_definition: Citizen's debit or credit card data was copied via an unauthorized card skimmer at an ATM or merchant POS machine, followed by cloned fraudulent withdrawals.
prototype_texts: Money was withdrawn from an ATM in another state while my physical debit card was in my wallet the whole time, indicating my card was cloned.
I received multiple unauthorized POS transaction alerts for shopping in a different city after using my credit card at a roadside restaurant.
Fraudsters used an ATM skimmer device to copy my debit card magnetic stripe and PIN, and made unauthorized cash withdrawals at 2 AM.
My bank account was debited through an unauthorized cloned card transaction without any OTP coming to my registered phone.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to unauthorized electronic extraction and copying of card data from payment terminals.
Applies to identity theft and fraudulent use of the citizen's unique card credentials and PIN code.

deepfake_extortion.issue_definition: Fraudsters use AI voice cloning or synthetic deepfake video to impersonate a son, daughter, or relative claiming they are in police custody or injured, demanding immediate funds.
prototype_texts: I received a phone call with my son's exact cloned voice weeping and saying he was arrested by police and needed 50000 rupees sent urgently for bail.
A video call showed my friend's face asking for urgent medical funds, but later I realized it was an AI deepfake avatar designed to cheat me.
Scammers cloned my daughter's voice using AI from her social media videos and called me demanding immediate ransom for her release.
A fraudster used an AI deepfake of a company director to instruct accounts staff to transfer company money to an offshore vendor account.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies directly to cheating by personation using advanced computer resources and AI synthetic media.
Applies to the dishonest misappropriation of unique biometric and vocal identification features.

online_betting_app_fraud.display_name: Illegal Online Betting & Gaming App Fraud
online_betting_app_fraud.issue_definition: Citizen was lured into depositing money into illegal offshore betting, casino, or color-prediction gaming apps where winnings are frozen and withdrawals blocked.
prototype_texts: I deposited money on an online betting app that advertised on Instagram, won 50,000 rupees, but the app blocked my withdrawals and demands a 20% security deposit.
A color prediction game app on Telegram made me deposit money with promises of doubling it, and then banned my account when I requested a payout.
I was duped by an online casino app where algorithmic rigging ensured initial wins, followed by complete forfeiture of my deposited savings.
An offshore sports betting application vanished with all my deposited funds after promising tax-free daily payouts.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personation and fraudulent digital gambling interfaces.
Applies because soliciting deposits for speculative schemes with promised returns falls under banned unregulated deposit schemes.

ecommerce_fake_seller_fraud.display_name: Social Media Fake Seller Non-Delivery Fraud
ecommerce_fake_seller_fraud.issue_definition: Citizen paid advance money for goods advertised on Instagram, Facebook, or a fake shopping website, after which the seller blocked them and never delivered the merchandise.
prototype_texts: I bought clothes from an Instagram boutique page and paid 3000 rupees via Google Pay, but the seller blocked me and never shipped the items.
An online shopping site advertised heavily discounted electronics, took my advance payment, and immediately shut down without delivering.
I ordered shoes from a Facebook marketplace seller who promised same-day delivery, took payment, and switched off their phone.
A seller on a social media platform provided a fake courier tracking number after receiving advance payment and deleted their account.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personation and inducing payment through electronic commerce interfaces without intention of delivery.

recruitment_job_offer_fraud.issue_definition: Citizen received fake appointment letters or overseas job offers purporting to be from reputed companies/airlines, demanding advance fees for medicals, uniforms, or visas.
prototype_texts: I received an official-looking job offer letter from a leading airline demanding 15,000 rupees for uniform charges and training security deposit.
Scammers pretending to be TCS HR conducted a fake telephonic interview, sent an appointment letter, and made me pay for laptop courier insurance.
A recruitment agency on LinkedIn promised me a high-paying job in Canada and extracted 1 lakh rupees for fake work visa processing.
I was cheated by a fake government job portal that collected application and verification fees for non-existent railway vacancies.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating corporate employers and government recruiting agencies using computer resources.

ransomware_data_hijacking.issue_definition: Malware infected citizen's device or small business network, encrypted personal files, databases, or accounting software, and demanded cryptocurrency ransom.
prototype_texts: All the files on my laptop were encrypted with a strange extension and a text file appeared demanding 500 dollars in Bitcoin to unlock them.
A ransomware attack locked our small business billing software and accounting data, displaying a ransom note with a timer.
My personal computer was infected by a virus that locked all my family photos and documents, demanding payment to a crypto wallet.
Malicious software took control of our clinic patient database and the attacker is demanding ransom to restore system access.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to unauthorized access, introducing computer contaminants, and altering or diminishing the utility of computer resources.
Criminalizes fraudulent computer-related damage and extortionate hacking under the IT Act.

data_breach_victimization.issue_definition: Citizen's sensitive personal, Aadhaar, or financial data was leaked due to cybersecurity failures or data breaches at a bank, telecom company, or corporate platform.
prototype_texts: My Aadhaar, phone number, and banking details were leaked in a major corporate data breach, leading to endless fraud calls and unauthorized loan attempts.
A hospital database breach exposed my private medical records and financial details on the dark web without the hospital notifying me.
A telecom operator's customer database leak led to hackers obtaining my subscriber details and attempting unauthorized SIM activations.
My credit card information saved on an e-commerce platform was compromised during a security breach, resulting in unauthorized transactions.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Imposes strict liability on corporate bodies dealing with sensitive personal data for negligence in maintaining reasonable security safeguards.
Applies where stolen identity credentials resulting from data breaches are misused by third-party fraudsters.

fake_charity_donation_fraud.display_name: Fake Charity & Disaster Relief Donation Scam
fake_charity_donation_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudsters created cloned disaster relief websites or fake UPI IDs impersonating authentic relief funds (PM-CARES, flood relief) to siphon citizen donations.
prototype_texts: I donated 5,000 rupees to a flood relief campaign on WhatsApp that had a fake UPI ID slightly misspelled to mimic the Chief Minister Relief Fund.
A fake charitable trust website collected donations for cancer patients with emotional photos, but the founders siphoned all funds into personal accounts.
Scammers created a spoofed PM-CARES donation portal that tricked citizens into transferring money to a private cyber criminal account.
I contributed to an emergency animal rescue fund on social media that turned out to be an organized fraudulent money extraction scam.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating government relief funds and established charities over computer resources.

defective_product.issue_definition: Citizen purchased physical goods that arrived broken, malfunctioning, or failing to meet quality and manufacturing specifications.
prototype_texts: The television I purchased online arrived with a cracked screen and the seller is refusing to replace it or honor the manufacturer warranty.
I bought a refrigerator that stopped cooling within three days of delivery, and the company technician refuses to acknowledge the defect.
The smartphone I received from an e-commerce platform does not turn on and came with a dead battery and damaged packaging.
A brand new washing machine broke down on its first use due to a faulty motor, and both the dealer and company refuse to take it back.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Statutory definition establishing that the product suffers from a defect in quality, standard, or performance.
Enables the consumer to file a formal legal complaint before the District Consumer Commission for replacement or refund.
Holds the manufacturer legally liable under product liability for manufacturing or design defects.

refund_denial.issue_definition: A business, retailer, or online platform refuses to issue a refund for returned goods, cancelled services, or undelivered orders within the applicable policy or statutory period.
prototype_texts: I returned an item within the seller's 7-day return window with all tags intact, but the company rejected the return and refuses to give my money back.
My flight or hotel booking was cancelled by the service provider, but they refuse to refund the booking amount and are offering unusable coupons instead.
I cancelled an e-commerce order before it was dispatched, yet the platform deducted the amount and refuses to process my refund.
A store took advance payment for furniture delivery, failed to deliver for two months, and now refuses to cancel the order or return the advance.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Refusing to refund money paid for goods not delivered or returned within specified terms constitutes an unfair trade practice.
Provides the statutory avenue to claim full refund, interest, and compensation before the Consumer Forum.

misleading_advertisement.issue_definition: Commercial advertisements or marketing promotions containing false product descriptions, deceptive performance guarantees, or fake discounts.
prototype_texts: A brand advertised 100% natural organic ingredients on the package, but laboratory testing showed it contains prohibited synthetic chemicals.
An advertisement claimed this device would reduce electricity consumption by 50%, but in reality it has zero effect on power usage.
An coaching institute advertised guaranteed government job placements and false topper endorsements to collect non-refundable course fees.
A car manufacturer advertised a mileage of 28 km per liter under normal driving, but the vehicle does not deliver even half of that under standard conditions.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Statutory definition of misleading advertisements covering false descriptions, deceptive guarantees, and concealment of key facts.
Empowers the Central Consumer Protection Authority to investigate misleading ads and levy penalties on companies and endorsers.
Allows affected consumers to seek redress and compensation for losses suffered due to false advertising.

service_deficiency.issue_definition: Shortcoming, inadequacy, or negligence in the quality and manner of performance of a paid service (hospital, airline, telecom, repair, insurance).
prototype_texts: An airline delayed my luggage for five days during an international trip, ruining my travel plans, and offered zero assistance or compensation.
My broadband internet service has been down for two weeks, and despite numerous tickets the telecom company has failed to fix the line or adjust my bill.
A hospital charged exorbitant unitemized fees and failed to provide standard medical care, resulting in severe health complications.
An automobile service center charged for replacing genuine parts during routine maintenance, but later inspection showed the original old parts were never changed.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Defines statutory deficiency in services for failure to maintain standard quality and negligence in contractual performance.
Enables consumers to initiate formal legal proceedings for damages and rectification before Consumer Commissions.

unfair_trade_practice.issue_definition: Deceptive commercial methods, including charging above Maximum Retail Price (MRP), refusal to provide cash memos, forced bundled purchases, or counterfeit promotions.
prototype_texts: A retail store insisted on charging 30 rupees above the printed Maximum Retail Price for cold drinks and packaged snacks.
A shopkeeper refused to provide a tax invoice or cash memo for an electronic appliance, claiming prices were higher if a bill was requested.
A cinema theater refused to allow outside water while charging three times the market rate for sealed bottled water inside the premises.
A merchant insisted that I could only purchase a mandatory high-priced accessory package if I wanted to buy the base vehicle.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Statutory definition covering overcharging beyond MRP, refusing cash memos, tied sales, and deceptive promotional gimmicks.
Provides the statutory mechanism to seek injunctions, refunds, and punitive damages against traders practicing unfair methods.

warranty_guarantee_denial.issue_definition: Authorized service center or manufacturer unlawfully rejects warranty coverage, refuses free repair, or demands payment for parts covered under active warranty.
prototype_texts: My laptop stopped working within the 1-year manufacturer warranty period, but the authorized service center falsely claimed physical damage and refused free repair.
The company is refusing to honor the 5-year compressor warranty on my air conditioner, claiming the spare part is unavailable and demanding full replacement cost.
An authorized mobile service center rejected my warranty repair on the grounds of water damage even though the phone was never exposed to liquids.
A dealer refuses to replace a defective battery covered under a written 2-year replacement guarantee, demanding that I pay 50% of the replacement price.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes product manufacturer liability for failing to conform to express warranties provided with the product.
Establishes product service provider liability where repair services fail to conform to warranty terms and conditions.
Empowers the consumer to file a claim before the District Commission to compel warranty enforcement and claim damages.

dark_patterns_hidden_charges.issue_definition: Online platforms using deceptive design techniques (dark patterns), such as pre-ticked insurance boxes, hidden convenience fees (drip pricing), or forced subscriptions.
prototype_texts: An airline ticket booking app added mandatory travel insurance and convenience fees at the final payment screen without my consent.
An online food delivery app enrolled me in a paid recurring subscription without explicit permission and refuses to cancel or refund the monthly charges.
An e-commerce website showed a product price of 500 rupees, but at checkout added multiple hidden platform fees that increased the cost by 50%.
A ticket booking website used countdown timers and deceptive popups to force me into purchasing unwanted cancellation protection that cannot be removed.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Deceptive design methods, drip pricing, and disguised charges are classified as unfair trade practices under the Act and CCPA Dark Pattern Guidelines.
Allows consumers to challenge deceptive commercial interface practices and recover unlawfully deducted fees.

expired_spurious_goods.issue_definition: A trader, shopkeeper, or e-commerce platform sold expired groceries, counterfeit branded goods, adulterated medicine, or imitation cosmetics.
prototype_texts: The supermarket sold me baby food products that had already passed their expiry date by two months, causing my child food poisoning.
I purchased branded perfume and cosmetics online which turned out to be counterfeit fake copies causing severe allergic reactions on my skin.
A chemist sold expired prescription medicines with the expiry date sticker intentionally scraped off and replaced with a fake label.
A seller delivered counterfeit vehicle engine oil in genuine branded packaging, which caused major damage to my motorcycle engine.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Selling spurious, adulterated, or expired goods is explicitly prohibited as an unfair and deceptive trade practice.
Imposes criminal punishment and heavy monetary fines for manufacturing, storing, or selling goods containing adulterants or spurious substances.
Provides the formal forum to claim compensation for medical expenses and harm caused by expired or counterfeit goods.

builder_delay_possession_dispute.issue_definition: A real estate developer or builder took substantial advance payments for a residential flat, but delayed possession by years or failed to provide promised amenities.
prototype_texts: The builder promised possession of my apartment within 3 years in the agreement, but it has been 6 years and the project construction is still incomplete.
I paid 90% of the flat cost, but the real estate developer refuses to hand over keys or pay the contractually agreed delay compensation interest.
The housing society builder unilaterally altered the building sanction plan and eliminated promised common amenities like parking and parks.
The builder is demanding extra unjustified infrastructure charges before handing over possession, threatening cancellation of my allotment.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Expressly classifies housing construction services within the statutory definition of consumer service.
Applies because indefinite delay and failure to deliver promised amenities constitutes severe deficiency in service.
Empowers home buyers to approach District, State, or National Consumer Commissions for refund with interest or possession.

medical_negligence_deficiency.issue_definition: A private hospital, nursing home, or doctor provided sub-standard treatment, committed gross surgical errors, or charged exorbitant unitemized billing.
prototype_texts: The hospital surgeon performed the operation negligently and left a surgical swab inside the patient, causing life-threatening complications.
A private nursing home administered the wrong medication dosage without checking allergy charts, resulting in severe organ damage.
The hospital management refused to release the patient's body until exorbitant disputed ICU charges were cleared in cash.
A diagnostic pathology lab issued an incorrect laboratory report that led the patient to undergo unnecessary painful surgical procedures.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes deficiency of service for breach of medical duty of care and sub-standard professional performance.
Provides the statutory avenue for patients and families to seek monetary compensation for medical negligence before Consumer Commissions.

coaching_institute_refund_dispute.issue_definition: A coaching center or test preparation institute refuses pro-rata refund of lump-sum advance tuition fees when a student withdraws due to poor teaching quality.
prototype_texts: I enrolled in a 2-year JEE coaching institute paying 2 lakhs in advance, but when my child left after one month due to poor teaching, they refused any refund.
A competitive exam coaching center advertised false faculty credentials and refuses to return the advance fee after I discontinued attendance.
The coaching academy made us sign a 'fees non-refundable under any circumstances' waiver, which violates consumer guidelines.
An educational coaching institute shut down its physical branch abruptly and shifted to low quality online videos, refusing tuition fee refunds.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Refusing pro-rata refund of advance fees and imposing non-refundable clauses is declared an unfair trade practice under CCPA Coaching Guidelines.
Allows students and parents to recover unutilized tuition fees and claim damages before the Consumer Commission.

airline_flight_baggage_dispute.issue_definition: An airline abruptly cancelled or delayed a flight without statutory passenger compensation, downgraded seat class, or lost checked-in passenger baggage.
prototype_texts: The airline cancelled my domestic flight 3 hours before departure, refused to arrange an alternate flight, and will not pay statutory compensation.
My checked-in baggage containing valuable personal belongings was lost by the airline, and they are offering an arbitrary low settlement.
The airline delayed our flight by 9 hours, kept passengers locked inside the aircraft without food or air conditioning, and provided zero assistance.
I paid for a premium economy ticket, but the airline involuntarily downgraded me to regular economy without refunding the fare difference.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Classifies transportation services (including commercial aviation) under statutory consumer service protections.
Applies because flight abandonment, extreme delays without care, and lost luggage constitute service deficiency.
Enables passengers to claim compensation exceeding airline carrier limits before the Consumer Commission for severe service breakdown.

insurance_claim_rejection_dispute.issue_definition: An insurance company (health, life, or motor) arbitrarily rejects or repudiates a genuine claim citing baseless pre-existing illness or technical exclusion clauses.
prototype_texts: The health insurance company rejected my cashless hospital claim for emergency surgery citing pre-existing hypertension that had nothing to do with the trauma.
My motor insurance claim for accidental vehicle damage was repudiated by the insurer claiming delay of two days in reporting the accident.
The insurance surveyor made arbitrary 60% deductions on genuine hospital bills, refusing to pay approved room rent and ICU charges.
The life insurance company denied death claim benefits to the nominee alleging non-disclosure of minor medical records from 10 years ago.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Explicitly includes insurance facilities in the statutory definition of consumer service.
Applies because arbitrary claim repudiation without medical justification constitutes gross deficiency of insurance service.
Enables policyholders to challenge illegal claim rejection and recover full claim amount plus interest before Consumer Commissions.

telecom_vas_billing_dispute.issue_definition: A telecom operator activated paid Value Added Services (caller tunes, games, sports alerts) without user consent and deducted recurring balance from the citizen.
prototype_texts: The mobile service provider activated a 99-rupee monthly caller tune without my consent and has been deducting my prepaid balance every month.
My telecom operator enrolled my number in an unsolicited daily gaming subscription that drained my phone balance without any confirmation SMS.
The cellular company converted my mobile plan to a higher tariff postpaid tier without my authorization and is demanding inflated bill payments.
A telecom company charged international roaming fees for a period when my phone was switched off and cellular data was disabled.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Activating unsolicited paid services without affirmative consumer consent is an unfair commercial practice.
Applies because wrongful billing deductions and failure to provide billing rectification constitutes service deficiency.
Provides the legal forum to seek reimbursement of deducted sums and punitive damages for consumer harassment.

vehicle_detention.issue_definition: Enforcement personnel forcibly confiscate vehicle ignition keys or impound a vehicle on the spot without lawful statutory authority or valid documentation.
prototype_texts: A traffic policeman snatched my bike keys from the ignition and detained my motorcycle on the roadside because I forgot to carry my pollution certificate.
A traffic officer forcibly took away my car keys during routine vehicle checking and refused to return them until an on-the-spot cash payment was made.
Traffic police took my car keys or bike key from ignition without my permission during checking on the road.
A police officer took my motorcycle key without my consent and seized my vehicle on the roadside.
Traffic officers impounded my commercial auto rickshaw without issuing an official seizure memo or citing a detainable offence under the Motor Vehicles Act.
An enforcement squad seized and towed my car for a minor parking dispute even though I was present and ready to move the vehicle immediately.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Strictly restricts vehicle detention to specified major violations (driving without licence/registration/permit) and mandates prescribed custody procedure.
Governs document inspection rules and limits an officer's authority when standard compliance is presented.

document_seizure_or_retention.issue_definition: A traffic officer seizes original physical documents (Driving Licence, RC book, Fitness certificate) without issuing a mandatory official acknowledgment or receipt.
prototype_texts: A traffic sub-inspector took away my original driving licence and told me to collect it from the police station next week without giving any paper or receipt.
The police officer seized my vehicle registration certificate (RC) on the spot and refused to provide an official seizure memo.
An enforcement team retained my physical driving licence for a minor lane violation and did not issue a temporary driving acknowledgment.
My original vehicle documents were confiscated during checking and the officer gave no written slip or challan reference to prove where they are.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that physical document seizure is restricted to suspected fraud or absconding, and legally requires issuing a temporary acknowledgment.

document_acceptance_or_verification.issue_definition: An enforcement officer refuses to accept valid driving licence, RC, or insurance records presented digitally via official government platforms DigiLocker or mParivahan.
prototype_texts: A traffic policeman refused to accept my driving licence and RC shown on DigiLocker, insisting that only physical laminated cards are valid.
The officer demanded my original physical insurance policy and issued a challan even after I presented the verified digital record on mParivahan.
Traffic police officers told me they do not accept electronic documents on mobile phones and threatened to impound my vehicle unless physical papers were shown.
I showed my valid electronic driving licence via the government DigiLocker app, but the officer refused to verify it and fined me for driving without a licence.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Regulates production of vehicle documentation to uniform officers in accordance with Central Government motor vehicle rules.
Grants full legal validity to electronic records, establishing that electronic documents in DigiLocker/mParivahan satisfy statutory requirements for physical documents.

wrongful_challan.issue_definition: Citizen received an incorrect e-challan or traffic fine issued against vehicle for a violation they did not commit, due to camera errors, cloned plates, or incorrect location.
prototype_texts: I received an e-challan on my phone for jumping a red light in a city I have never visited, with a photo of a completely different car model.
A traffic camera issued a speeding challan to my registered scooter showing a photo of a speeding commercial truck with a misread number plate.
I was issued a wrongful challan for driving without a helmet, but the photographic evidence attached clearly shows I was wearing a certified helmet.
An erroneous e-challan was generated against my vehicle registration number while my car was parked inside my home garage all day.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs composition and payment of compounding fines, confirming that disputed fines need not be paid unconditionally.
Provides the statutory procedure for contesting disputed traffic challans before Virtual Courts or Magistrates.

bribe_demand.display_name: Unofficial Cash Demand / Bribe Demand by Enforcement Officer
bribe_demand.issue_definition: A traffic officer or enforcement team demands an unofficial cash payment on the spot and refuses to issue an official printed or digital government challan.
prototype_texts: The traffic police officer stopped me and demanded 500 rupees in cash without giving any receipt or entering the violation on his electronic challan machine.
An enforcement officer threatened to impose a 10,000 rupee fine unless I paid him 1,000 rupees in cash on the spot to let me go.
The officer refused my request to pay the penalty online through the official portal and insisted that I hand over cash immediately.
A group of traffic personnel demanded personal cash payments at a checkpoint and threatened vehicle detention when I asked for an official receipt.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Specifies that compounding fees can only be collected under official State Gazette notification and must be accompanied by an official receipt.
Limits an officer's coercive authority over vehicle documents during roadside checks.

unlawful_towing.issue_definition: Vehicle was towed away unlawfully (while driver/passengers were sitting inside, without public announcement), or suffered physical damage during towing.
prototype_texts: A towing crane lifted and towed my car away while my elderly mother was sitting inside the vehicle, ignoring our loud calls to stop.
Traffic towing staff towed my motorcycle without making any loudspeaker announcement and damaged the front suspension and handlebar during lifting.
My car was parked legally in a marked spot, but towing contractors picked it up anyway and scratched the bumper while dragging it onto the flatbed.
Towing operators demanded 2000 rupees in cash at the impound yard for towing charges but refused to provide any official municipal or police receipt.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs removal of unattended vehicles and explicitly holds towing agencies legally liable for any loss or damage caused during removal or impoundment.

drunk_driving_breathalyzer_dispute.issue_definition: Enforcement officers allege drunken driving based on subjective smell without using an approved breath analyser device, or reuse unhygienic mouthpieces.
prototype_texts: The traffic police officer claimed I was drunk driving just by smelling my breath, refused to administer a breathalyzer test, and impounded my car.
An officer insisted on using a dirty, used mouthpiece on the breathalyzer machine and threatened to arrest me when I demanded a sealed fresh straw.
The breath test showed a false positive reading after I used mouthwash, but the officers refused my request for an immediate hospital blood test.
Traffic personnel demanded a 10,000 rupee cash settlement at an alcohol checkpoint and refused to provide the printed digital slip from the testing device.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Sets the statutory threshold of 30 mg alcohol per 100 ml blood detected via approved breath test or laboratory testing.
Regulates the lawful procedure for demanding specimens of breath and breath analyser testing by uniformed officers.

seatbelt_helmet_camera_dispute.issue_definition: An automated traffic enforcement camera generated an erroneous fine for not wearing a seatbelt or helmet due to clothing occlusions, camera angle, or bad lighting.
prototype_texts: I was issued a 1000-rupee e-challan for driving without a seatbelt, but the camera photo clearly shows the black seatbelt across my dark shirt.
An automated camera fined my pillion rider for no helmet, but she was wearing a full-face ISI helmet that was obscured by shadow in the low-res photo.
I received a seatbelt violation challan for a car model where the factory seatbelt anchor is positioned lower than the camera's line of sight.
A traffic camera misidentified a Sikh driver wearing a traditional turban and generated an automated helmet penalty.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs the statutory requirement and one thousand rupee fine for safety belt compliance.
Governs the statutory requirement for protective headgear compliance.
Provides the statutory mechanism to contest disputed automated photographic challans before Virtual Courts.

emergency_vehicle_obstruction_dispute.issue_definition: A citizen was fined for allegedly obstructing an ambulance or fire brigade vehicle when road gridlock made moving aside physically impossible.
prototype_texts: I received a 10,000 rupee challan for failing to give way to an ambulance, but my car was trapped in standstill bumper-to-bumper traffic.
Traffic cameras fined me for obstructing an emergency vehicle when moving left would have caused a head-on collision with pedestrians.
An enforcement team issued a penalty for not pulling over for a siren vehicle when there was no physical shoulder space on the flyover.
I was penalized for stopping at a red signal while an ambulance was behind me, because crossing into the intersection would cause a major accident.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs compounding of motor vehicle offences and conditions for challenging penalty notices.
Provides the statutory avenue for presenting factual traffic constraints and physical impossibility before a Magistrate.

puc_verification_dispute.issue_definition: A traffic officer refuses to verify an active Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate on the central Parivahan portal and insists on a physical paper certificate.
prototype_texts: The traffic police officer fined me 10,000 rupees for an expired pollution certificate even though my renewed PUC was active on the Parivahan database.
An officer refused to look at my valid online PUC record on my phone and demanded a physical printed certificate from a local testing center.
I got a PUC violation challan generated at an automated checkpoint while my vehicle had undergone valid emissions testing two days earlier.
Traffic personnel threatened to seize my vehicle registration certificate because I did not possess a laminated copy of my pollution slip.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs penalties for operating motor vehicles in violation of road safety and emission pollution standards.
Governs production of vehicle compliance records to uniform officers.
Gives complete legal validity to electronic records, confirming online database records satisfy statutory document requirements.

delayed_wages.issue_definition: An employer habitually or substantially delays monthly salary payment beyond the statutory deadline mandated by the Code on Wages.
prototype_texts: My employer has not paid my monthly salary for the past two months and keeps giving false promises of payment dates without clearing dues.
Our company routinely delays salaries until the end of the next month, violating our employment contract and legal salary payment deadlines.
My salary for the previous month has been delayed by over 45 days, causing severe personal financial hardship with rent and loans.
The management has withheld salary payments for all employees in our department for over six weeks citing cash flow problems.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that monthly wages must be paid before the expiry of the seventh day of the succeeding month.
Enables employees to file statutory claims before designated Labour Authorities for wage recovery and compensation.

unpaid_wages.issue_definition: An employer completely refuses to pay accrued wages, denies compensation for work performed, or withholds salary indefinitely without legal cause.
prototype_texts: I worked for three months at a private firm, but when I asked for my pending salary, the owner refused to pay and stopped answering my calls.
The company has completely withheld my last two months of salary after I informed them that I would not be renewing my contract.
My employer terminated my employment abruptly and refused to clear my outstanding wages for the days already worked.
I completed all assigned work for the company, but the management refuses to disburse my earned wages citing fabricated performance issues.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes the employer's strict legal liability to disburse earned wages for all completed work periods.
Empowers Labour Authorities to award full unpaid wages plus compensation up to ten times the claimed amount.

unauthorized_deduction.issue_definition: An employer makes arbitrary, illegal, or non-statutory cuts from an employee's salary, such as penalty charges, equipment fees, or unproven damage claims.
prototype_texts: My company deducted 15,000 rupees from my monthly pay slip without my consent, claiming it was an internal penalty for missing quarterly targets.
The employer made a 30% deduction from my wages claiming company-wide cost cutting, even though my employment contract guarantees a fixed salary.
Arbitrary salary deductions were made from my monthly paycheck for alleged office equipment wear-and-tear without any prior notice or proof.
My employer deducted half my salary as a penalty because I took two days of authorized medical leave with a valid doctor certificate.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Strictly prohibits all unauthorized wage deductions and restricts lawful deductions to specific statutory exceptions under legal limits.
Provides the statutory route for workers to challenge illegal salary deductions and recover withheld sums through the Labour Commissioner.

minimum_wage_violation.issue_definition: An employee or worker is paid less than the statutory minimum wage rate notified by the government for their category of employment and location.
prototype_texts: I am working 10 hours a day as a security guard, but the agency only pays me 6,000 rupees a month, which is far below the government minimum wage.
Our factory pays daily wage laborers 250 rupees per day, whereas the state notified minimum wage for our sector is 450 rupees per day.
The contractor is underpaying all cleaning staff, disbursing wages below the statutory minimum floor wage and threatening termination if we complain.
My monthly wage is lower than the mandatory minimum wage prescribed for skilled workers in our municipal area.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that employers must pay not less than the statutory minimum rate of wages fixed by the appropriate government.
Authorizes Labour Authorities to order payment of wage differences and impose penalties up to ten times the shortfall on defaulting employers.

overtime_wage_denial.issue_definition: An employer compels an employee to work beyond standard working hours (8-9 hours per day or 48 hours per week) without paying mandatory double-rate overtime wages.
prototype_texts: Our company makes us work 12 hours every day including Saturdays, but refuses to pay any overtime allowance or additional wages for extra hours.
My manager forces me to work 3 extra hours daily after my shift ends and refuses to compensate me at the legal overtime rate of double wages.
I was made to work on weekends and public holidays without any compensatory leave or overtime pay as required by law.
The management regularly demands extended shift work exceeding 55 hours a week without paying the statutory overtime wage rate.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Requires employers to pay overtime wages at not less than twice the normal rate of wages for any work performed beyond normal working hours.
Enables workers to claim unpaid overtime dues and statutory compensation through the Labour Commissioner.

final_settlement_withheld.display_name: Full and Final Settlement Withheld After Resignation / Termination
final_settlement_withheld.issue_definition: An employer withholds full and final settlement (F&F), earned salary, leave encashment, or experience letters past the statutory 2-working-day deadline following resignation or termination.
prototype_texts: I served my complete notice period and resigned two months ago, but the company has not released my Full and Final settlement or earned salary.
My previous employer is holding back my final settlement dues, gratuity, and relieving letter because I refused to sign a non-compete waiver.
The company terminated my services without notice and refuses to disburse my accrued wages and severance pay within the required two working days.
It has been over 60 days since my last working day, and the HR department refuses to process my pending wage arrears and final clearance.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Explicitly mandates under subsection (2) that all wages payable upon resignation, dismissal, or termination must be paid within two working days.
Empowers Labour Authorities to enforce immediate settlement disbursement along with statutory interest and compensation.

pf_deduction_non_deposit.display_name: Provident Fund (PF) Deduction Not Deposited by Employer
pf_deduction_non_deposit.issue_definition: An employer regularly deducts Provident Fund (PF) contributions from an employee's monthly salary slip, but fails to deposit the funds into the EPFO member account.
prototype_texts: My company deducted 1,800 rupees for PF from my salary every month, but when I checked my EPFO passbook online, zero contributions were deposited for a year.
The employer made monthly statutory PF deductions on my pay slips, but the funds were misappropriated and never credited to my UAN.
I discovered that our firm has not deposited employer or employee PF contributions for the last six months despite active pay cuts.
The management deducted employee provident fund contributions and closed the business without remitting the accumulated deductions to EPFO.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Deductions for provident fund contributions are lawful only if remitted to the statutory fund; withholding deducted employee wages constitutes an unauthorized deduction.
Provides the statutory route to recover misappropriated wage deductions and report employer defaults to authorities.

gender_wage_discrimination.issue_definition: An employer pays lower wages or unequal salaries to female employees or certain staff for performing identical work or work of a similar nature.
prototype_texts: My male colleague and I were hired for the identical software development role with equal experience, but the company pays him 40% higher salary because he is male.
Female factory workers on our production line are paid 300 rupees a day while male workers doing the exact same packing work receive 500 rupees.
The management reduced the compensation scale for women returning from maternity leave while maintaining male compensation levels.
Our employer systematically discriminates in wage increments and bonuses on the ground of gender for identical work outputs.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Strictly prohibits any discrimination among employees on the ground of sex in matters relating to wages for the same work or work of similar nature.
Empowers Labour Authorities to order equalization of wages and award arrears and compensation to affected employees.

notice_period_clawback_dispute.display_name: Notice Period Salary Clawback & Buyout Dispute
notice_period_clawback_dispute.issue_definition: An employer deducts an exorbitant notice period buyout fee or claws back earned wages when an employee resigns early due to hostile working conditions.
prototype_texts: When I resigned giving 15 days notice instead of 90 days, the company seized my entire 2-month earned salary and demanded an extra 50,000 rupees in cash.
The employer made a massive salary deduction claiming notice period recovery even though my employment contract allows notice buyout at basic pay.
The management refused to waive notice period after I was hospitalized, and confiscated my pending monthly paycheck to recover buyout fees.
The company deducted full gross salary for 3 months notice buyout from my earned dues rather than adjusting basic wage components.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Strictly restricts permitted wage deductions, confirming that excessive or unilateral salary clawbacks not authorized by law are illegal.
Mandates that earned wages for completed work days must be disbursed within two working days of resignation.
Enables workers to recover withheld earned wages and challenge punitive notice deductions before the Labour Commissioner.

gratuity_withholding_dispute.issue_definition: An employer refuses to disburse statutory gratuity after an employee completes 5 or more years of continuous service and resigns or retires.
prototype_texts: I worked continuously for 7 years at a manufacturing firm, but upon retirement the employer refused to pay my statutory gratuity amount.
My previous company withheld my gratuity of 3 lakh rupees citing vague allegations of financial losses without any formal departmental inquiry.
It has been five months since I resigned after 6 years of service, and the HR department refuses to process my statutory gratuity application.
The management deducted commercial company losses from my gratuity settlement, in direct violation of statutory gratuity protections.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates prompt settlement of all termination dues and terminal benefits upon conclusion of employment.
Provides the statutory mechanism to enforce disbursement of withheld terminal dues and claim statutory interest before Labour Authorities.

breach_of_contract.issue_definition: A contracting party violates express terms, refuses to deliver agreed commitments, or fails to perform obligations specified in a legally binding agreement.
prototype_texts: The interior designer signed a contract promising to finish home renovation within two months, but took advance money and stopped all work.
A commercial vendor failed to deliver contracted supplies by the agreed deadline, causing heavy financial losses to my manufacturing business.
A service contractor violated the non-disclosure and exclusivity clauses in our signed business agreement, sharing proprietary designs with competitors.
The other party broke the explicit terms of our written memorandum of understanding and refused to fulfill their agreed contractual responsibilities.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Primary statutory remedy entitling the injured party to compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract.
Permits termination of contract when a party has refused to perform their contractual promises in their entirety.

security_deposit_dispute.issue_definition: A landlord, property owner, or leasing agency refuses to refund a rental security deposit after the tenant vacates the premises in accordance with the agreement.
prototype_texts: My landlord refuses to return my rental security deposit of 80,000 rupees after I vacated the flat with one month advance notice as agreed.
The property owner made arbitrary deductions of 50,000 rupees from my lease deposit for routine wall repainting that is not permitted under our agreement.
I completed my rental tenure and handed over the apartment keys in good condition, but the house owner refuses to refund my caution deposit.
A commercial landlord is withholding our company lease security deposit four months after the commercial agreement was lawfully terminated.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to recover financial losses and wrongfully withheld funds under the terms of a breached lease or license agreement.
Enforces the statutory obligation of contracting parties to perform their reciprocal promises to refund deposits.

freelance_vendor_non_payment.issue_definition: A client, agency, or company commissions and accepts freelance, creative, software, or consulting deliverables, but refuses to pay the agreed invoices or fees.
prototype_texts: I completed website development and graphic design work for a client who accepted the deliverables, but they now refuse to pay my final invoice.
A business hired me as a freelance software consultant, took all the source code and launched the app, but has stopped responding to my payment requests.
I delivered photography and video editing services for a corporate event, but the event agency refuses to disburse my professional fees.
A client accepted delivery of custom manufactured goods without objection, but has delayed payment of my commercial invoices for over four months.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes the obligation of any person enjoying the benefit of a non-gratuitous lawful service to pay fair compensation for it.
Provides the legal basis for claiming damages, unpaid invoice amounts, and interest for breach of commercial commitments.

unilateral_contract_termination.display_name: Unilateral Contract Termination Without Notice or Cause
unilateral_contract_termination.issue_definition: A party abruptly cancels or repudiates an ongoing commercial, service, or partnership agreement without providing the contractually required notice period or legitimate cause.
prototype_texts: A corporate client terminated our annual maintenance contract overnight without giving the mandatory 60 days notice specified in the agreement.
A business partner unilaterally cancelled our vendor supply contract halfway through the term, leaving me with heavy raw material debts.
The project owner cancelled our written construction agreement abruptly without any notice or valid reason, refusing to reimburse expenses already incurred.
A company terminated our service agreement without cause or cure notice, in direct breach of the agreed termination provisions.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Addresses unilateral refusal to perform contractual promises and outlines consequences of wrongful repudiation.
Explicitly entitles the party affected by wrongful cancellation or non-fulfilment of contract to compensation for sustained damages.
Provides damages for direct financial losses resulting from improper contract cancellation.

non_compete_clause_dispute.issue_definition: An employer or commercial partner threatens an employee, consultant, or professional with lawsuits and damages for joining a competitor under an illegal non-compete clause.
prototype_texts: My former employer sent a legal notice threatening a 20 lakh lawsuit because I joined another software firm, claiming I violated a 2-year non-compete clause.
A company is withholding my relieving letter and experience certificate because I refused to sign an agreement not to work in the same industry.
A consulting agency claims I cannot practice my lawful profession for three years after leaving their firm and is threatening court injunctions.
My ex-business partner threatens legal action claiming my new independent freelance work breaches an unreasonable post-termination restriction clause.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Statutory rule establishing that every agreement or contract clause restraining anyone from exercising a lawful profession, trade, or business is VOID and unenforceable in India.

coercion_duress_agreement_dispute.display_name: Agreements Signed Under Coercion or Duress
coercion_duress_agreement_dispute.issue_definition: A citizen or business owner was coerced or intimidated into signing an unfair settlement deed, release waiver, or property transfer under unlawful detention of property or physical threats.
prototype_texts: The builder refused to hand over my house keys until I signed an unfair waiver agreeing not to claim any compensation for 3 years of construction delays.
A contractor locked our factory machinery and threatened physical violence unless we signed an inflated settlement deed accepting exorbitant bills.
I was pressured into signing an unfair release deed while my vehicle and tools were unlawfully detained by the client.
The other party coerced me into signing a revised contract under economic duress while holding back my rightful payments.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Defines statutory coercion as committing or threatening unlawful acts or unlawful detention of property to force an agreement.
Declares that agreements entered into without free consent due to coercion or fraud are voidable at the option of the aggrieved party.

advance_deposit_forfeiture_dispute.display_name: Advance Payment Forfeiture & Unfair Penalty Clauses
advance_deposit_forfeiture_dispute.issue_definition: A service provider, event venue, or contractor forfeits 100% of an advance deposit or booking fee under a harsh penalty clause despite incurring no actual financial loss.
prototype_texts: A wedding banquet hall cancelled our booking due to unforeseen family tragedy and forfeited our entire 2 lakh advance deposit citing non-refundable terms.
A customized furniture maker failed to deliver on time, but when I cancelled the order they forfeited my 50,000 rupee advance as a contractual penalty.
A training institute forfeited my entire 40,000 rupee advance booking fee even though I informed them 3 months before the batch commencement.
An equipment vendor retained my entire advance deposit under a penalty clause when delivery was delayed by supply chain issues.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Limits penalty clauses and advance forfeitures strictly to reasonable compensation for actual proven loss, prohibiting arbitrary 100% forfeiture.
Provides the statutory basis to recover excessive forfeited amounts and limit deductions to actual mitigated expenses.

nda_breach_trade_secret_dispute.issue_definition: A business partner, employee, or contractor violates a signed non-disclosure agreement by leaking confidential business plans, source code, or proprietary client data to third parties.
prototype_texts: A software contractor signed our strict non-disclosure agreement but uploaded our proprietary source code to a public GitHub repository.
Our business consulting partner leaked confidential pricing formulas and client databases to a competitor in direct violation of our signed NDA.
A former executive shared confidential manufacturing designs and prototype blueprints with a rival firm despite an active non-disclosure covenant.
A vendor shared our unpublished product launch plans with external marketing agencies in breach of contractual confidentiality provisions.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Primary statutory remedy providing financial damages and compensation for direct and foreseeable losses caused by breach of confidentiality terms.
Enforces the binding legal obligation of contracting parties to perform their contractual confidentiality promises.

fake_stock_ipo_allotment_scam.issue_definition: Fraudsters create fake institutional trading applications (FII/FPI accounts) promising guaranteed allotment in oversubscribed IPOs and steal investor deposits.
prototype_texts: I was added to a VIP institutional WhatsApp trading group that promised guaranteed allotment in hyped IPOs through a fake FII trading app.
Scammers made me download an unverified trading APK that showed fake allotments of 500 shares in a popular IPO, and then blocked my withdrawal.
I invested 4 lakh rupees in an institutional pre-IPO placement platform that claimed to have direct institutional quota, and the app has vanished.
A fake stock trading adviser induced me to deposit funds into a corporate bank account for exclusive IPO allotment and stopped responding.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating institutional market intermediaries and brokerage platforms over computer networks.
Statutory prohibition completely banning unregulated deposit solicitation and unauthorized investment schemes.

aeps_fingerprint_cloning_fraud.display_name: Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS) Biometric Fraud
aeps_fingerprint_cloning_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudsters clone or lift fingerprints from public land registry deed portals and execute unauthorized cash withdrawals at AePS micro-ATMs without OTP.
prototype_texts: Money was debited from my bank account via an AePS biometric transaction at a customer service point in another district while I was at home.
Scammers lifted my fingerprint from land registration documents online and used silicon clones to steal money through Aadhaar payment system.
I received an SMS alert that 10,000 rupees was withdrawn using AePS fingerprint authentication without any OTP arriving on my phone.
Unauthorized cash was withdrawn from my rural bank account through micro-ATM AePS terminals using forged biometric credentials.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to criminal identity theft involving the fraudulent use of another person's unique biometric identification features.
Applies to unauthorized digital access and illegal extraction of funds from computer banking systems.

overseas_cyber_slave_job_trafficking.display_name: Overseas Cyber Slavery & Job Fraud Compound Scam
overseas_cyber_slave_job_trafficking.issue_definition: Citizens are lured by fake overseas data entry/IT job offers in Thailand or Dubai, trafficked to call center compounds in Southeast Asia, and forced to execute cyber fraud.
prototype_texts: My brother was offered a customer support job in Thailand, but on arrival he was taken across the border to Cambodia and forced to run crypto scam calls.
A recruitment agency sent me for a data operator role in Dubai, but I was trapped in a guarded compound and forced to scam people online under threat.
Scammers promised high-paying IT jobs in Southeast Asia, seized passports upon arrival, and coerced victims into running dating scams.
My relative is trapped in a call center compound in Myanmar where their phone is monitored and they are forced to run investment frauds.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to transnational cheating by personation and fraudulent recruitment over computer networks.

courier_rto_address_update_scam.display_name: Courier Delivery Address Update Phishing Scam
