courier_rto_address_update_scam.issue_definition: Fraudulent SMS claiming a package could not be delivered due to an incomplete address, urging the citizen to click a link, update details, and pay a nominal re-delivery fee.
prototype_texts: I got an SMS saying my India Post parcel could not be delivered due to wrong house number, and clicking the link debited 20,000 rupees from my card.
A text message claimed my courier package was held at the hub and demanded a 5-rupee address update fee, which captured my net banking password.
I received a fake parcel delivery alert with a link asking for my debit card CVV to verify redelivery of an order I had placed on Amazon.
Scammers sent a WhatsApp notification pretending to be Blue Dart stating my shipment was returned and instructed me to pay a nominal re-dispatch charge.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to fraudulent extraction and unauthorized use of banking passwords, card credentials, and OTPs.
Applies to cheating by personating courier agencies and postal services using communication networks.

bank_account_freeze_mule_involvement.display_name: Bank Account Freeze Due to Cyber Crime Mule Taint
bank_account_freeze_mule_involvement.issue_definition: A citizen's bank account was frozen by cyber police or banks because an innocent P2P crypto sale, online marketplace sale, or freelance payment received funds originating from cyber fraud.
prototype_texts: My savings account was abruptly frozen by cyber crime police from another state because money from a P2P Binance trade turned out to be stolen cyber fraud funds.
The bank put a debit freeze on my business account citing an investigation from Telangana Cyber Cell regarding an innocent freelance payment I received.
I sold old electronics on OLX and received payment via UPI, but the buyer was a scammer using victim money, and now my entire account is frozen.
My primary bank account was placed on hold under a cyber police lien because a secondary transaction layer received tainted cybercrime funds.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Relevant where innocent account holders suffer disruptive loss of access to their legitimate personal funds and digital assets.
Addresses the underlying cyber cheating and fraudulent transaction chain that led to the account freeze.

google_review_rating_task_scam.display_name: Google Review & Hotel Rating Task Scam
google_review_rating_task_scam.issue_definition: Citizens are solicited via WhatsApp to earn money for posting fake Google Maps reviews or hotel ratings, paid small initial sums, and then extorted for large merchant deposits.
prototype_texts: I was offered 150 rupees per Google rating on WhatsApp, earned 450 rupees initially, but then they locked 80,000 rupees in a fake merchant portal.
Scammers promised daily wages for reviewing restaurants on Google Maps, added me to a Telegram group, and defrauded me of 1.5 lakhs in prepaid tasks.
I joined an online part-time job rating hotels on travel sites, was induced to pay money to upgrade my rating commission level, and the admin blocked me.
A work-from-home review job paid me small amounts on UPI to build trust, then demanded 30,000 rupees for a 'combo task' that cannot be withdrawn.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personation and false task promises over digital messaging platforms.
Applies because soliciting deposits under the guise of guaranteed task returns constitutes an illegal unregulated deposit scheme.

fake_traffic_challan_apk_scam.display_name: Fake Traffic Challan APK Malware Scam
fake_traffic_challan_apk_scam.issue_definition: Fraudsters send SMS alerts claiming a traffic challan is pending, containing an APK link that installs malware to steal SMS verification codes and banking passwords.
prototype_texts: I received an SMS warning that my car had a pending traffic fine of 1000 rupees, and downloading the Parivahan APK link hacked my phone and emptied my bank.
A message asked me to pay an overdue traffic challan through an APK file download, which secretly forwarded all my OTPs to an unknown number.
Scammers created a fake e-challan SMS that installed malicious software on my mobile device, allowing them to access my banking apps.
I clicked on a link to check a traffic penalty photo, an application installed itself automatically, and unauthorized debits occurred shortly after.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to unauthorized computer access and introducing computer contaminants and malware into the victim's mobile device.
Applies to cheating by personating government traffic enforcement authorities over electronic communications.

credit_card_reward_points_expiry_scam.display_name: Credit Card Reward Points Expiry Phishing Scam
credit_card_reward_points_expiry_scam.issue_definition: Deceptive SMS messages claiming bank reward points worth thousands of rupees are expiring tonight, directing citizen to a cloned portal to capture card numbers and OTPs.
prototype_texts: I got a text saying my 8,500 SBI card reward points worth 8,500 rupees were expiring today, and clicking the redemption link drained 50,000 from my card.
A fake bank message asked me to redeem accumulated reward points into cash by entering my credit card CVV and OTP on a cloned website.
I clicked on a link to claim an expiring credit card voucher, entered the verification code sent by SMS, and an unauthorized merchant transaction occurred.
Scammers sent a fraudulent link promising direct bank credit for unused reward points, which captured my card credentials.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to fraudulent harvesting and unauthorized use of credit card numbers, CVVs, and electronic authentication codes.
Applies to cheating by personating commercial banking institutions and reward redemption portals.

ev_battery_thermal_range_defect.display_name: Electric Vehicle (EV) Battery Defect & Range Shortfall
ev_battery_thermal_range_defect.issue_definition: An electric vehicle (EV) battery suffers catastrophic thermal runaway/fire or delivers less than half of the manufacturer's certified advertised range.
prototype_texts: My brand new electric scooter battery caught fire while charging, causing extensive damage, and the manufacturer refuses to replace the vehicle.
The electric car was advertised with a 350 km range per charge, but in real-world driving it barely provides 110 km before dying.
The EV manufacturer refuses to honor the 8-year battery warranty after the battery capacity degraded by 60% within the first year of purchase.
An electric two-wheeler suddenly shuts off while driving at high speed due to a defective battery management system (BMS), posing grave safety hazards.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Holds the vehicle manufacturer strictly liable under product liability for design defects, manufacturing flaws, and battery fire hazards.
Defines severe shortcoming in performance and advertised range as a statutory product defect.
Enables consumers to claim full vehicle replacement, refund of purchase cost, and compensation for safety hazards.

water_purifier_ro_amc_scam.issue_definition: An authorized or third-party water purifier technician installs fake duplicate filters, contaminates membranes, or refuses promised service under active AMC contracts.
prototype_texts: The authorized RO technician replaced my water purifier filters with duplicate counterfeit parts that contaminated our drinking water with heavy metals.
I purchased a 2-year comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for my water purifier, but the company refuses to send technicians for maintenance.
The service technician broke the internal booster pump during routine servicing and demanded 4,000 rupees to fix their own damage.
A water purifier company refused to honor the warranty on a newly installed water filter that leaked and ruined our modular kitchen cabinets.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies because failure to provide promised maintenance and sub-standard repair constitutes statutory deficiency in service.
Holds product service providers legally accountable for deficient maintenance and failure to conform to service warranties.
Provides the statutory route to recover AMC fees, damages for kitchen property damage, and replacement of parts.

gym_fitness_club_abrupt_closure.display_name: Gym & Fitness Club Abrupt Closure Refund Dispute
gym_fitness_club_abrupt_closure.issue_definition: A fitness center or gym collects hefty annual advance membership fees and abruptly shuts down its premises within months, refusing refunds.
prototype_texts: I paid 25,000 rupees for an annual gym membership, but the gym management shut down operations after two months and refuses to refund my balance.
A fitness club collected renewal fees for a year, packed up all equipment overnight, and the owners have switched off their phones.
The gym promised personal trainer sessions and swimming pool access in our contract, but abruptly cancelled both without refunding the fees.
A national gym franchise abruptly closed its local branch and refuses to transfer my active membership to another branch or process a refund.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Collecting long-term advance fees and shutting down service without pro-rata refund constitutes an unfair trade practice.
Empowers affected members to file collective or individual complaints before Consumer Commissions for refund of advance fees.

courier_cargo_damage_loss.display_name: Courier & Cargo Parcel Damage / Total Loss
courier_cargo_damage_loss.issue_definition: A courier or parcel logistics service severely damages fragile goods, loses urgent original documents or educational certificates, and refuses fair compensation.
prototype_texts: A domestic courier company completely lost my original university graduation degree certificates and is offering an arbitrary 100-rupee settlement.
I shipped a laptop via a premium courier with declared insurance value, and the package arrived crushed with the laptop completely destroyed.
The cargo logistics company delayed delivery of perishable goods by two weeks, causing total spoilage of the consigned inventory.
A courier tracking portal showed my valuable package was delivered, but it was never handed over to me and the company refuses to investigate.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes deficiency of service for negligence in handling consigned goods and failure to ensure safe delivery.
Enables consumers to bypass boilerplate arbitrary low-liability clauses and claim actual damages and compensation before Consumer Commissions.

electronics_planned_obsolescence.issue_definition: A smartphone or electronics manufacturer pushes a mandatory software update that deliberately slows device speed, ruins battery life, or disables hardware components.
prototype_texts: After installing the official manufacturer system update, a persistent green line appeared across my AMOLED screen and the company demands 15,000 for a screen replacement.
A software update pushed by the phone manufacturer severely throttled the processor speed and reduced battery life from 24 hours to 4 hours.
The company pushed a firmware update that deliberately disabled third-party replacement battery compatibility on my tablet.
A smart TV manufacturer updated the operating system and removed core streaming apps that were advertised as primary features on the retail box.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Classifies artificial degradation of device performance and hardware defects caused by software updates as product defects.
Holds the product manufacturer liable under product liability for introducing design flaws or defective firmware.
Enables consumers to compel free hardware replacement, display repair, or refund before the Consumer Commission.

holiday_timeshare_membership_scam.display_name: Holiday Timeshare & Vacation Club Membership Fraud
holiday_timeshare_membership_scam.issue_definition: Citizens are lured into high-pressure sales presentations with free gift vouchers and locked into expensive 25-year holiday memberships with hidden maintenance fees and zero booking availability.
prototype_texts: I was invited to a hotel for a free holiday gift voucher and pressured into signing a 25-year vacation membership for 2 lakhs, but can never book any room.
A holiday resort company promised 7 days of free luxury stays annually, but every time I attempt to book, they claim no rooms are available.
The vacation club company demands 20,000 rupees in annual maintenance charges every year despite never providing a single confirmed reservation.
The timeshare company refused to cancel my membership within the statutory 10-day cooling-off period and is demanding recurring annual fees.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Deceptive marketing, false promises of room availability, and unconscionable contract terms constitute unfair trade practices.
Enables victims of timeshare traps to seek contract cancellation, full refund of membership fees, and punitive damages.

overcharging_authorized_parking_scam.issue_definition: Contractors managing municipal, railway, or market parking lots demand cash rates 3 to 5 times higher than the official notified government tariff and refuse printed receipts.
prototype_texts: The municipal parking contractor demanded 100 rupees for two hours of car parking when the official government board clearly states 20 rupees.
Railway station parking attendants refused to let me exit unless I paid 150 rupees in cash without any computer-generated receipt.
The parking attendant scratched out the printed government fee on the parking slip and wrote an inflated handwritten charge.
A commercial parking operator demanded overnight parking charges for a 30-minute stay and threatened physical violence when I asked for a receipt.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Clarifies that compounding and official fee collections must strictly adhere to notified rates with valid receipts.
Overcharging beyond government notified tariffs and refusing printed receipts constitutes an unfair commercial trade practice.

tinted_glass_sunfilm_fine_dispute.issue_definition: A traffic officer imposes penalties or threatens vehicle impoundment for factory-fitted tinted safety glass that complies with statutory 70% VLT visibility standards.
prototype_texts: A traffic policeman fined me for tinted glass even though my car has factory-fitted OEM glass compliant with the 70% Visual Light Transmission rule.
The officer scratched my car window with a key claiming I had applied black sunfilm, but the glass came tinted directly from the car manufacturer.
Traffic personnel issued a challan for dark windows without using any lux meter or optical transparency testing device.
I was penalized for factory safety glass on my imported car that satisfies all Central Motor Vehicles Rules visibility requirements.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs penalties for operating vehicles in violation of road safety and technical equipment standards.
Provides the statutory mechanism to contest subjective visual assessments before a Virtual Court or Magistrate.

speed_trap_radar_calibration_dispute.display_name: Speed Trap & Defective Radar Calibration Dispute
speed_trap_radar_calibration_dispute.issue_definition: An automated speed camera or interceptor issues a speeding challan on a road where legal speed limit signboards were absent or contradictory, or where device calibration is unverified.
prototype_texts: I received a speeding challan for driving at 65 km/h on a multi-lane expressway where there were no signboards indicating a 50 km/h speed limit.
A speed radar camera issued a fine on a road with conflicting speed signs: one signboard said 70 km/h while a lower sign said 40 km/h.
The speed interceptor vehicle claimed my small hatchback was travelling at 145 km/h, which is physically impossible for that vehicle model.
An automated camera fined me for speeding on a bridge where speed limit boards were completely hidden behind overgrown tree branches.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that speed limits must be officially notified and clearly displayed by traffic signboards erected by authorities.
Provides the statutory right to contest speeding fines where signboards were defective or camera calibration is unproven.

interstate_vehicle_entry_harassment.display_name: Interstate Vehicle Driving & Road Tax Harassment
interstate_vehicle_entry_harassment.issue_definition: Traffic police stop and threaten to seize an out-of-state registered private car or motorcycle during a short visit, falsely claiming immediate local road tax payment is mandatory.
prototype_texts: Traffic police stopped my Delhi-registered car in Bengaluru and threatened to seize it unless I paid full Karnataka lifetime road tax on the spot.
An officer harassed me for driving my Maharashtra-registered bike in another state during a 2-week vacation, demanding local registration.
Police officers threatened to detain my private vehicle because the number plate belongs to another state, ignoring my temporary visit proofs.
Enforcement personnel demanded proof of local address and road tax receipts for an out-of-state car visiting for temporary medical treatment.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Explicitly permits private vehicle owners to keep and drive their out-of-state registered vehicle in another state for up to twelve months without re-registration.
Governs document production duties, establishing that valid national registration documents satisfy statutory requirements.

maternity_benefit_paid_leave_denial.display_name: Maternity Benefit & Paid Leave Salary Denial
maternity_benefit_paid_leave_denial.issue_definition: An employer refuses to disburse statutory 26 weeks paid maternity salary, cuts pay during pregnancy, or terminates a female employee upon discovering her pregnancy.
prototype_texts: My employer stopped paying my monthly salary as soon as I took my approved maternity leave and refuses to disburse the statutory 26 weeks wages.
The company terminated my employment citing performance reasons two weeks after I informed HR about my pregnancy.
The management forced me to sign a resignation letter before granting maternity leave, refusing paid maternity compensation.
A private firm refused to disburse maternity wages claiming their company policy only provides 4 weeks of unpaid leave.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates strict time limits for payment of earned wages and statutory remuneration during approved leave periods.
Empowers Labour Authorities to order immediate payment of unpaid wages and award compensation up to ten times the shortfall.

sales_commission_incentive_withholding.issue_definition: An employer withholds contractually promised sales commissions, project performance bonuses, or variable pay after targets were officially achieved.
prototype_texts: I achieved 150% of my annual sales quota, but the company refuses to disburse my contractually agreed 2 lakh sales commission.
The management changed the incentive calculation policy retrospectively after the financial year closed to deny earned performance bonuses.
The employer withheld my quarterly sales incentives after I submitted my resignation, claiming incentives are forfeited upon exit.
The company celebrated closing the enterprise deal I brought in, but refused to pay the promised 5% commission specified in my appointment letter.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes that wages, including any remuneration payable under employment terms and contractual incentives, must be paid on time.
Prohibits unauthorized deductions or arbitrary forfeiture of earned contractual remuneration components.
Provides the statutory avenue before Labour Authorities to recover unpaid commission and claim compensation.

daily_wage_contract_worker_wage_theft.display_name: Contract Labour Daily Wage Theft & Middleman Cuts
daily_wage_contract_worker_wage_theft.issue_definition: A labour contractor or intermediary pockets illegal commission deductions from daily wage workers, disbursing cash below the government notified minimum rate.
prototype_texts: The labour contractor receives 600 rupees per worker from the principal employer, but only gives us 350 rupees in cash at the end of the day.
Contract labourers on the construction site are subjected to a daily 100-rupee commission cut by the middleman who threatens dismissal if we object.
The contractor makes us sign blank wage registers showing full payment while giving us half the statutory minimum wage in cash.
Our factory contractor stopped wage payments for 20 migrant workers and ran away without settling daily wage arrears.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that employers and contractors must disburse not less than the statutory minimum rate of wages fixed by the government.
Holds principal employers and contractors liable before Labour Authorities for wage shortfalls with penalties up to ten times the claimed amount.

compulsory_unpaid_training_internship.issue_definition: A company forces graduates or trainees to work 40-hour weeks performing core commercial work for months on 'unpaid probation' without stipend or minimum wage.
prototype_texts: The company hired me as an 'unpaid intern' for 6 months, but makes me do full-time client billable software work for 9 hours every day without a single rupee.
A private firm forced freshers into a 6-month mandatory 'unpaid training period' doing commercial production work, threatening to withhold degrees.
The employer hired marketing trainees with promises of future employment, made them work 50 hours a week for free, and fired them after 3 months.
A media agency replaced regular salaried designers with revolving batches of unpaid interns doing full commercial design work without stipend.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that any employee performing core economic work must be paid not less than the statutory minimum wage rate.
Authorizes Labour Authorities to reclassify sham unpaid internships as regular employment and award minimum wage arrears.

event_wedding_vendor_cancellation_defaul.issue_definition: A wedding hall, caterer, decorator, or photographer abruptly cancels their services days before an event after taking advance payment, refusing a substitute or refund.
prototype_texts: The wedding banquet hall cancelled our booking three days before the ceremony claiming a double booking, and refuses to refund our 3 lakh advance deposit.
Our wedding caterer took a 1 lakh advance and stopped answering calls 48 hours before the reception, forcing us to hire an expensive last-minute substitute.
The professional event photographer failed to appear for our wedding ceremony after taking advance payment and lost all our event memories.
An event decorator backed out of a signed corporate convention agreement the night before the event, causing severe business embarrassment and losses.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Entitles the aggrieved party to financial compensation and damages for all direct financial losses incurred, including costs of emergency substitute vendors.
Applies where a contracting party refuses or disables themselves from performing their contractual commitments in their entirety.

consulting_retainer_fee_default.issue_definition: A corporate client engages a consultant, legal advisor, or agency on a monthly retainer contract, utilizes strategy reports and advisory hours, and defaults on invoices.
prototype_texts: Our marketing consulting firm provided advisory services to a corporate client under a signed monthly retainer, but the client stopped paying invoices 4 months ago.
A client engaged me as a financial advisor on a 50,000 monthly retainer, consumed all advisory reports, and refuses to clear outstanding fees.
The corporate client terminated our consulting contract without notice and refused to pay the pending retainer fees for the completed quarter.
A business hired our cybersecurity agency on a monthly retainer, implemented our technical recommendations, but defaulted on our service invoices.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes the obligation of any party enjoying the benefit of non-gratuitous professional services to make full compensation for it.
Provides the legal basis to recover unpaid invoice amounts, interest, and damages for breach of retainer contracts.

equipment_lease_machinery_breakdown.issue_definition: Industrial machinery, construction vehicles, or generator equipment leased on contract breaks down immediately, but the lessor refuses repair and demands full monthly rent.
prototype_texts: We leased an industrial generator on contract for our construction site, but it broke down on the second day and the lessor refuses repair while demanding full rent.
The crane rental company provided a defective crane that caused a site shutdown for two weeks, and they refuse to deduct breakdown days from the bill.
A commercial equipment lessor delivered machinery that failed factory safety inspections and refuses to replace it or refund our advance lease deposit.
The lessor leased earthmoving equipment with pre-existing engine faults and is attempting to charge our firm for repairing their old defects.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies where the lessor disables themselves from providing functional equipment in accordance with the lease purpose.
Entitles the lessee to compensation for losses suffered due to project delays and costs incurred hiring substitute machinery.

commercial_lease_lock_in_penalty_dispute.display_name: Commercial Lease Lock-In Penalty & Force Majeure
commercial_lease_lock_in_penalty_dispute.issue_definition: A commercial tenant terminates an office lease due to severe building structural hazards, water leakage, or force majeure, while the landlord attempts to enforce an unlawful multi-year lock-in penalty.
prototype_texts: We were forced to vacate our leased office because heavy ceiling water leakage ruined our computers, but the landlord is demanding 2 years of lock-in rent.
The building suffered severe structural cracks and municipal condemnation, yet the commercial landlord refuses to refund our deposit citing lock-in terms.
Our startup had to close office operations during a government-ordered shutdown, and the landlord is attempting to enforce an unconscionable lock-in penalty clause.
The landlord failed to provide promised fire safety clearances and electricity load, forcing us to exit, and is suing for 18 months of lock-in period rent.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Restricts contractual penalty stipulations strictly to reasonable compensation for actual proven damage, prohibiting extortionate multi-year lock-in penalties.
Applies the doctrine of frustration when structural hazards, municipal orders, or unforeseen events render commercial premises unusable.
Obligates the landlord to restore and refund security deposits when the lease contract becomes frustrated or void.

digital_signature_certificate_theft.display_name: Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) Misuse & Corporate Fraud
digital_signature_certificate_theft.issue_definition: A company director, chartered accountant, or business owner's Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) was stolen or cloned to execute unauthorized filings on MCA21 or file fake GST returns.
prototype_texts: Someone obtained a fraudulent Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate in my name and used it to file unauthorized director resignation forms on MCA21.
My digital signature token was stolen from my office desk and used to submit unauthorized government procurement bids.
Fraudsters forged my identity documents to get a duplicate DSC issued by a Certifying Authority and transferred company shares.
An unauthorized digital signature was affixed to tax audit filings and commercial contracts without my knowledge or consent.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Directly criminalizes the fraudulent or dishonest use of another person's electronic signature, password, or digital certificate.
Imposes civil compensation liability for unauthorized access, data alteration, and tampering with electronic records.

whatsapp_account_call_forwarding_hijack.display_name: WhatsApp Account Hijack via Call Forwarding (MMI Code Scam)
whatsapp_account_call_forwarding_hijack.issue_definition: Fraudsters trick the citizen into dialing a MMI call-forwarding code on their phone under the pretext of delivery or prize, redirecting voice verification calls to hijack WhatsApp.
prototype_texts: A caller told me to dial *401*<phone number> to receive a courier parcel, and within minutes my WhatsApp was hacked and logged out.
I dialed an MMI number instructed by a fake customer care executive, which forwarded my calls and allowed scammers to register my WhatsApp on their phone.
Scammers used call forwarding to intercept the automated voice call verification code and stole my WhatsApp account to solicit money from my contacts.
My WhatsApp account was compromised after I dialed a shortcode sent via SMS, and fraudsters are messaging my family asking for emergency transfers.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to identity theft involving the fraudulent misappropriation and misuse of unique authentication credentials and SMS/voice verification codes.
Applies to cheating by personating customer service executives to induce dialing malicious call-forwarding codes.
Applies to unauthorized access and tampering with mobile communication settings.

fake_defence_armyman_olx_fraud.display_name: Fake Defence Personnel / Army Officer Marketplace Scam
fake_defence_armyman_olx_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudsters pose as Indian Army officers or CISF personnel on OLX/marketplace sites, sharing forged military ID cards to sell vehicles or furniture for cheap, extracting advance transport fees.
prototype_texts: A seller on OLX claimed to be an Indian Army subedar transferred to a military base, showed a fake army canteen card, and took 25,000 for vehicle army transport.
Someone posing as a CISF officer at the airport offered to sell a second-hand Royal Enfield motorcycle and demanded gate pass fees before vanishing.
A fraudster used a stolen photograph in army uniform to build trust on a classifieds site and tricked me into paying advance freight charges.
I paid multiple installments for military transport insurance and gate clearance for furniture I bought from an alleged army officer on OLX.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies directly to cheating by personating armed forces personnel and government defense officers over communication networks and marketplace platforms.

fastag_recharge_wallet_phishing.display_name: FASTag Recharge & Toll Blacklist Phishing Scam
fastag_recharge_wallet_phishing.issue_definition: Citizen receives an urgent SMS warning that their vehicle FASTag is blacklisted or blocked due to KYC non-compliance, directing to a cloned NETC page that drains bank accounts.
prototype_texts: I got an SMS saying my FASTag was blacklisted and gave a link to update KYC, which opened a fake toll portal that stole 40,000 rupees from my bank.
A message warned that highway toll passage would be denied unless I recharged my FASTag immediately via a link, which captured my net banking password.
Scammers created a fake NPCI NETC FASTag customer care website that extracted my debit card credentials when I called to resolve an overcharged toll.
I clicked on a link to claim an expired FASTag cashback and entered an OTP, which resulted in unauthorized electronic transfers.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to fraudulent identity theft and theft of net banking passwords, CVVs, and verification credentials.
Applies to cheating by personating national electronic toll collection agencies and highway authorities over digital communication.

hotel_flight_ticket_reseller_scam.display_name: Fraudulent Travel Ticket Reseller & Stolen Card Scam
hotel_flight_ticket_reseller_scam.issue_definition: Citizen buys heavily discounted flight tickets or luxury hotel packages from an unauthorized online travel agent who uses stolen credit cards to book, resulting in cancellation on travel day.
prototype_texts: I booked international flight tickets through a travel agent on Instagram offering a 40% discount, but the airline cancelled my tickets at the airport citing credit card fraud.
A travel reseller took 50,000 rupees in cash for holiday hotel bookings made using compromised credit cards, leaving my family stranded without accommodation.
An unauthorized ticket booking page issued me a confirmed PNR, but the airline voided the ticket because the booking was made using stolen card credentials.
I was cheated by an online holiday agent who sold me bogus flight itineraries and disappeared after receiving bank transfers.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies to cheating by personating legitimate IATA travel agencies and booking platforms using computer resources.
Applies to receiving and dealing in stolen computer data and compromised financial card credentials to make bookings.

synthetic_identity_credit_card_fraud.display_name: Synthetic Identity Theft & Bogus Credit Accounts
synthetic_identity_credit_card_fraud.issue_definition: Fraudsters combine citizen's genuine PAN card number with fabricated names, altered addresses, and forged utility bills to obtain credit cards and personal loans that ruin the citizen's CIBIL score.
prototype_texts: My CIBIL credit score crashed by 200 points because multiple defaulting credit cards were issued by banks using my PAN number combined with a fake name.
Lending apps issued personal loans to an unknown individual who used my authentic tax identification number with forged KYC documents.
Debt recovery collection agencies are harassing me for a 3 lakh credit card default taken by a synthetic identity using my PAN credentials.
I discovered a fraudulent auto loan registered against my PAN on my credit report for a vehicle purchased in another state.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Directly criminalizes the fraudulent or dishonest use of unique identification features, PAN credentials, and electronic authentication records of another person.
Applies to unauthorized computer data tampering and extracting financial benefits through compromised credit systems.

gold_jewellery_hallmarking_purity_scam.issue_definition: A jeweller sells gold jewellery claimed to be 22-carat (916 purity) or with fake hallmark stamps, which government laboratory testing proves is severely adulterated or lower caratage.
prototype_texts: The jeweller sold me a gold necklace as 22-carat 916 hallmarked, but when tested at a certified BIS assaying center, it was only 14-carat gold.
A jewellery showroom charged full 24-carat gold rate and issued an unverified hallmark bill that could not be verified on the BIS Care app.
The jeweller charged for 50 grams of gold including the weight of decorative wax and synthetic stones at the full gold price rate.
A retail jewellery store sold ornaments with fake etched hallmark symbols and refused to buy back or exchange their own jewellery.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Falsely representing that goods are of a particular standard, quality, or grade (such as 22k hallmarked) constitutes an unfair trade practice.
Imposes criminal punishment and heavy penalties for manufacturing or selling products containing adulterants or sub-standard precious metals.
Provides the statutory avenue for consumers to recover the price difference, full refund, and compensation before Consumer Commissions.

hotel_restaurant_mandatory_service_charg.display_name: Restaurant Forced Service Charge & Excessive Billing
hotel_restaurant_mandatory_service_charg.issue_definition: A restaurant, hotel, or eatery forcibly levies a discretionary 5% to 10% 'Service Charge' on the food bill, charges GST on the service charge, and refuses removal despite consumer objections.
prototype_texts: The restaurant added a mandatory 10% service charge of 450 rupees on my dining bill and the manager refused to let us leave unless it was paid.
An eatery added a service charge to our food bill and levied 5% GST on the service charge amount, violating CCPA guidelines.
The cafe menu had fine print stating '10% service charge compulsory', which is directly prohibited under national consumer protection guidelines.
A restaurant staff member threatened us when we requested removal of the service charge from our bill after experiencing terrible service.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Levying mandatory service charges and tying it to service availability is an unfair trade practice under Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) Guidelines 2022.
Empowers consumers to seek refund of unlawfully collected charges, compensation, and punitive damages before the Consumer Commission.

e_commerce_refusal_of_open_box_delivery.display_name: E-Commerce Open Box Delivery Breach & Missing Contents
e_commerce_refusal_of_open_box_delivery.issue_definition: An e-commerce platform delivery agent refuses to open the parcel for 'Open Box Delivery' verification of expensive electronics, forces delivery OTP, and the package contains stones or dummy goods.
prototype_texts: I paid for Open Box Delivery for a 70,000 rupee laptop, but the delivery person refused to open the seal, pressured me for the OTP, and the box contained a piece of wood.
The delivery courier refused to let me inspect the smartphone box before sharing the OTP, and when opened inside, the mobile phone was missing.
An online shopping platform rejected my missing product complaint claiming the delivery was marked successful via customer OTP.
The delivery agent opened the outer packaging but refused to let me power on the television to verify display damage before demanding the handover OTP.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies because failure to adhere to advertised Open Box inspection protocols constitutes severe deficiency in delivery service.
Holds product sellers and e-commerce platforms liable under product liability for missing goods and tampered consignments.
Provides the statutory avenue for consumers to recover the full purchase price and compensation before the Consumer Commission.

packaged_food_misleading_nutrition_claim.display_name: Packaged Food Misleading Nutrition & Health Claims
packaged_food_misleading_nutrition_claim.issue_definition: A food or beverage brand markets products with deceptive claims (e.g., 'Zero Sugar', '100% Real Juice', 'Heart Healthy'), while laboratory testing proves high concentrations of hidden sugar and additives.
prototype_texts: A health drink marketed for children advertised 'Zero Sugar', but laboratory tests proved it contains over 35% hidden maltodextrin and glucose syrup.
A bread manufacturer advertised '100% Whole Wheat Atta Bread', but the ingredient list in tiny font reveals 70% refined maida flour.
Packaged cooking oil advertised 'Zero Cholesterol & Heart Healthy' while containing trans fats exceeding statutory FSSAI limits.
A fruit beverage marketed as '100% Real Fruit Juice' was found to contain less than 10% fruit pulp with artificial sweeteners and preservatives.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Statutory definition of misleading advertisements covering false descriptions, deceptive nutritional guarantees, and deliberate concealment of key ingredients.
Empowers the Central Consumer Protection Authority to investigate misleading health claims and levy heavy penalties on manufacturers.
Enables consumers to claim damages and seek discontinuance of deceptive food marketing before Consumer Commissions.

bank_safe_deposit_locker_theft_loss.display_name: Bank Safe Deposit Locker Theft & Damage Dispute
bank_safe_deposit_locker_theft_loss.issue_definition: A commercial bank safe deposit locker was burgled, compromised by bank staff fraud, or water/termite damaged, and the bank refuses liability claiming it has no knowledge of contents.
prototype_texts: Burglars broke into the bank locker room and stole our ancestral gold jewellery, and the bank management claims zero liability under old rules.
Termites infested my bank safe deposit locker and completely destroyed original property title deeds and shares stored inside.
Bank staff collaborated with unauthorized persons to break open my locker without notice and the contents were stolen.
Water seepage inside the bank basement locker vault ruined gold ornaments and currency, and the bank refuses any compensation.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Classifies banking and safe deposit facilities within the statutory definition of consumer service.
Applies because failure to maintain adequate vault security and environmental protection constitutes gross deficiency of service.
Empowers locker holders to claim statutory compensation (up to 100 times the annual locker rent under RBI norms) plus full damages before Consumer Commissions.

automobile_manufacturing_defect_lemon_ve.issue_definition: A brand new car or commercial vehicle suffers recurring engine, transmission, or electronic failures within the first 6 months, spending weeks in repair garages without resolution.
prototype_texts: My new car has broken down 7 times in the first 4 months due to engine stalling and transmission locking, and the dealer refuses to replace the defective vehicle.
The steering system on my new vehicle locks unpredictably while driving at highway speeds, and the authorized workshop cannot diagnose or fix the defect.
A brand new car suffered complete electrical failure and sudden battery discharge 3 days after delivery, spending 45 days in the service center.
The vehicle manufacturer refuses to replace a car with recurring chassis cracks and brake failures, offering only cosmetic welding repairs.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes product manufacturer liability for manufacturing defects, design flaws, and failure to conform to express roadworthiness standards.
Defines persistent vehicle breakdowns and performance failures as statutory product defects.
Provides the statutory avenue for consumers to compel vehicle replacement or full refund of on-road vehicle price with interest.

high_security_registration_plate_hsrp_di.display_name: High Security Registration Plate (HSRP) Fine Dispute
high_security_registration_plate_hsrp_di.issue_definition: Traffic police issue a heavy fine for non-possession of High Security Registration Plates (HSRP) on an older vehicle where the owner's online booking is pending with official receipt.
prototype_texts: A traffic policeman fined me 5,000 rupees for not having an HSRP plate on my older car, even though I showed the active online booking receipt with an appointment date next week.
Traffic officers issued a non-HSRP challan during an enforcement drive while the state transport website was completely down and offline for plate bookings.
I was penalized for an older registration plate while driving through another state where HSRP enforcement dates differ from my registered home state.
An officer refused to consider my official receipt showing my HSRP installation was delayed due to lack of dealer inventory.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs penalties for operating motor vehicles in violation of road safety standards and equipment regulations.
Provides the statutory mechanism to contest disputed registration equipment challans before Virtual Courts.

one_way_no_entry_signage_obscured.display_name: No Entry / One-Way Street Obscured Signage Dispute
one_way_no_entry_signage_obscured.issue_definition: A citizen is fined for entering a 'No Entry' or 'One Way' road where the mandatory statutory traffic signboard was missing, broken, turned away, or hidden by tree branches.
prototype_texts: I was issued a 1000-rupee challan for driving down a one-way street, but the 'No Entry' signboard at the junction was completely hidden by dense tree leaves.
Traffic police stationed at the end of a street penalized motorists where the 'No Entry' board had fallen down and was lying on the ground.
The one-way traffic sign had been vandalized and painted over, making it completely impossible for visiting drivers to see.
An enforcement camera issued an automated fine for wrong-way driving on a newly converted one-way street with zero advance warning boards.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Places a statutory obligation on road authorities to place and maintain standardized, visible traffic signs to regulate traffic restrictions.
Provides the statutory right to contest traffic penalties where signage was defective, obscured, or absent.

zebra_crossing_pedestrian_stop_line_disp.display_name: Zebra Crossing & Stop Line Faded Road Marking Dispute
zebra_crossing_pedestrian_stop_line_disp.issue_definition: An automated camera generates a red-light or stop-line violation challan when the painted stop lines on the road were completely faded, erased, or covered by rain puddles.
prototype_texts: A traffic camera fined me 1000 rupees for stopping over the zebra line, but the painted white stop line on the road was completely erased and invisible.
I was issued a stop line violation challan during heavy monsoon rains where standing water completely covered the road markings.
My car was forced onto the pedestrian crossing because an oversized city bus in front stopped abruptly and blocked the signal line.
An automated camera captured my front bumper inches over a faded stop line that has not been repainted by the municipal corporation in two years.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs general penalties for minor regulatory traffic infractions where painted road marking compliance is at issue.
Provides the statutory mechanism to contest automated camera findings where road markings are unmaintained.

commercial_vehicle_overloading_weighbrid.issue_definition: Transport or traffic enforcement officers issue an exorbitant overloading penalty on a goods truck based on visual guesswork without weighing the vehicle on a certified weighbridge.
prototype_texts: Enforcement officers issued a 40,000 rupee overloading challan on my commercial goods truck based solely on visual estimation without weighing the vehicle.
The RTO squad took my truck to a private uncalibrated weighbridge that showed a 5-tonne error compared to my government electronic toll weighbridge receipt.
Officers refused my demand to be weighed on an official electronic weighbridge and demanded cash bribes to avoid off-loading penalties.
A commercial transport truck carrying lightweight bulky goods (foam/boxes) was penalized for overloading despite being well under the gross vehicle weight.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that suspected overloading must be verified by requiring the driver to drive to an authorized weighbridge or weighing device.
Governs statutory penalties for driving vehicles exceeding permissible weight and off-loading procedures.

unauthorized_uniform_tool_security_deduc.display_name: Compulsory Uniform & Tool Salary Deduction Dispute
unauthorized_uniform_tool_security_deduc.issue_definition: An employer makes mandatory monthly salary cuts for company uniforms, safety shoes, ID access cards, or work tools, lowering net pay below statutory limits.
prototype_texts: My company deducted 4,000 rupees from my first monthly salary for company uniform and safety shoes that are mandatory for workplace safety.
The security agency deducts 500 rupees every month from guards' wages as a recurring 'equipment maintenance fee'.
A private firm deducted 15,000 rupees from my paycheck as a 'laptop security deposit' that was never mentioned in my employment contract.
The employer made a 20% wage deduction for mandatory company identity cards and parking tags, lowering my net pay below the minimum wage.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Strictly prohibits all deductions from wages except those specifically authorized under the Code, prohibiting arbitrary uniform or equipment cuts.
Authorizes Labour Authorities to order reimbursement of unauthorized deductions plus statutory compensation to affected workers.

layoff_retrenchment_compensation_denial.issue_definition: An employer abruptly terminates or lays off employees during corporate restructuring or site closure without disbursing statutory retrenchment compensation or notice pay.
prototype_texts: The company laid off 50 employees overnight due to cost cutting and refused to pay our statutory retrenchment compensation of 15 days pay per year of service.
My employer shut down our branch office without warning and refused to provide 1-month notice pay or severance settlement.
The management terminated my services during an organizational restructuring and withheld my earned salary arrears and severance dues.
A private firm disguised an involuntary retrenchment as 'voluntary resignation' to evade paying statutory termination compensation.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates under subsection (2) that all wages and terminal dues payable upon retrenchment, dismissal, or closure must be paid within two working days.
Empowers Labour Authorities to award full unpaid retrenchment compensation, wage arrears, and statutory penalties.

casual_contract_worker_overtime_wage_the.issue_definition: Security guards, sanitation staff, or contract workers are forced to work continuous 12-hour shifts 30 days a month without overtime pay or a mandatory weekly day of rest.
prototype_texts: The security agency makes us work continuous 12-hour shifts every single day of the month without any weekly off or overtime pay.
Contract sanitation staff are compelled to work 84 hours a week on basic wages without receiving the mandatory double-rate overtime pay.
The contractor threatens immediate termination if any worker asks for their legally mandated weekly day of rest or overtime compensation.
Our warehouse forces contract packing staff to work back-to-back double shifts without meal intervals or overtime allowances.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates statutory daily working hour limits and legally guarantees a mandatory paid day of rest in every period of seven days.
Requires employers and contractors to pay overtime wages at not less than twice the normal rate of wages for any work in excess of normal hours.
Authorizes Labour Authorities to hold contractors and principal employers liable for overtime arrears and statutory compensation.

illegal_salary_cut_during_medical_quaran.display_name: Salary Withholding During Medical Leave & Workplace Injury
illegal_salary_cut_during_medical_quaran.issue_definition: An employer cuts 100% of monthly wages or terminates an employee who is recovering from a verified workplace injury or authorized medical leave supported by doctor certificates.
prototype_texts: I suffered an injury while operating machinery on the factory floor, and the employer stopped paying my salary during my two months of medical recovery.
The company deducted full wages for three weeks when I was hospitalized with severe pneumonia despite submitting hospital discharge summaries.
Management terminated my employment while I was on authorized medical sick leave and refuses to disburse my earned salary arrears.
The employer made a 50% deduction from my monthly paycheck claiming my medical illness caused an unexcused business disruption.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Restricts lawful wage deductions strictly to statutory exceptions, prohibiting arbitrary salary forfeiture during authorized medical sickness.
Provides the statutory mechanism before Labour Authorities to recover withheld wages and claim compensation for workplace injury.

intellectual_property_assignment_payment.display_name: Freelance Software & IP Assignment Payment Default
intellectual_property_assignment_payment.issue_definition: A client, software agency, or startup takes full assignment of copyright, proprietary source code, or design assets under contract, and defaults on the agreed assignment fees.
prototype_texts: I developed a complete mobile app source code and transferred full intellectual property rights to a startup, but they defaulted on my final 2 lakh payment.
A client accepted delivery of my commercial brand identity designs, registered the trademark in their name, and refuses to pay the agreed licensing fee.
An enterprise company deployed our custom software modules on their live servers under an IP assignment contract and has ignored invoices for six months.
A client took full transfer of patent documentation and proprietary blueprints under contract and ceased all communication without settling dues.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Establishes the obligation of any party enjoying the commercial benefit of lawful non-gratuitous services or IP deliverables to make full compensation.
Provides the legal basis to claim damages, unpaid assignment consideration, and statutory commercial interest for breach of contract.

unilateral_price_escalation_in_fixed_con.display_name: Unilateral Price Escalation in Fixed-Price Contract
unilateral_price_escalation_in_fixed_con.issue_definition: A building contractor, fabricator, or vendor signs a fixed-price turnkey agreement, and halfway through the project halts work demanding an arbitrary 30% to 50% price escalation.
prototype_texts: The construction contractor signed a fixed-price house building agreement for 30 lakhs, halted work halfway, and demands an extra 10 lakhs to finish.
A commercial fabricator stopped delivery of custom industrial machinery demanding a 40% price hike that is not permitted under our fixed contract.
The interior designer locked my apartment keys and refused to complete the ongoing renovation unless I agreed to an uncontracted cost increase.
A software agency took advance payment on a fixed-scope milestone contract and now refuses to deliver the codebase without double the agreed budget.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Enforces the binding statutory obligation of contracting parties to perform their promises in accordance with fixed contractual terms.
Entitles the client to compensation and damages for project delays and extra costs incurred hiring substitute contractors to complete the work.
Applies where the contractor refuses or disables themselves from performing their agreed promises in their entirety.

security_guard_facility_vendor_abrupt_wa.display_name: Facility Management & Security Vendor Abrupt Walkout
security_guard_facility_vendor_abrupt_wa.issue_definition: A facility management company or private security agency abruptly withdraws all security guards from a residential complex or commercial facility without contractual notice, causing theft or property damage.
prototype_texts: The security agency abruptly withdrew all security guards from our apartment society overnight without notice, and multiple vehicle thefts occurred the same week.
A facility management contractor abandoned our commercial office park without giving the mandatory 60 days contractual notice.
The housekeeping and security vendor walked out halfway through our annual contract after taking a quarterly advance, leaving the premises unattended.
A private security vendor terminated services with zero transition period, in direct breach of the agreed termination covenants.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Entitles the facility owner or residents welfare association (RWA) to compensation for direct losses, theft damages, and extra costs of hiring emergency security.
Applies where a service contractor wrongfully puts an end to ongoing performance before contract expiry.

misrepresentation_of_franchise_business_.issue_definition: A franchisor sells a commercial franchise by presenting fabricated financial audits and inflated profit projections, inducing the franchisee into heavy investments in an unviable business.
prototype_texts: The franchisor showed me falsified store balance sheets promising a guaranteed 1 lakh monthly profit, but the outlet is making continuous heavy losses.
I paid a 10 lakh franchise fee based on deceptive marketing claims of exclusive territory rights, which the franchisor later sold to another party.
A franchise company induced me into leasing a commercial property based on fake footfall figures and refuses to provide promised supply chain support.
The franchisor misrepresented the operational viability of their retail business model and concealed active regulatory bans on their primary product.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Statutory definition of misrepresentation covering untrue positive assertions and misleading statements regarding the commercial subject of an agreement.
Declares that contracts entered into without free consent due to misrepresentation or fraud are voidable at the option of the aggrieved party.
Entitles the party rightfully rescinding the agreement to full compensation for all sustained financial damages.

nach_unauthorized_autodebit_fraud.issue_definition: Unauthorized e-mandate or NACH recurring auto-debit set up on a bank account using stolen credentials or phishing without the account holder's consent.
prototype_texts: My bank account is getting deducted every month for 5000 rupees through an unauthorized NACH e-mandate that I never approved.
Someone set up a recurring ECS auto-debit on my savings account using forged details or stolen OTP.
Money was debited from my salary account for an automated loan EMI or insurance mandate I never signed up for.
A bogus fintech company created an unauthorized recurring mandate on my netbanking and money is deducting automatically without my permission.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies where the fraudster impersonated the account holder to create a deceptive recurring payment mandate.
Covers unauthorized debit and extraction of funds from a computer banking system.

telecom_kyc_data_leak_sale.display_name: Telecom / Corporate Insider KYC Data Breach and Sale
telecom_kyc_data_leak_sale.issue_definition: Corporate insider or telecom service provider staff accessing confidential customer personal data under contract and leaking or selling it without consent.
prototype_texts: An employee at a telecom store or customer service centre leaked my Aadhaar, PAN, and call detail records to third parties.
My personal KYC documents and mobile phone records were sold illegally on Telegram by a company insider without my consent.
A broadband provider staff leaked my confidential residential and identity documents resulting in harassment and cyber blackmail.
Someone working in a service provider company breached contract and sold my private personal database for commercial profit.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Directly penalizes any person or intermediary accessing personal information under contract who discloses it without consent to cause wrongful gain or loss.
Mandates statutory compensation by body corporates failing to maintain reasonable security practices to protect sensitive personal data.

spyware_stalkerware_device_monitoring.display_name: Covert Spyware and Stalkerware Device Monitoring
spyware_stalkerware_device_monitoring.issue_definition: Unauthorized covert installation of spyware, stalkerware, or keyloggers on a personal computing device to surreptitiously intercept private communications and data.
prototype_texts: Someone secretly installed a hidden spy app or stalkerware on my smartphone that monitors my WhatsApp messages, calls, and live GPS location.
A malicious keylogger APK was installed on my laptop without my permission to capture my passwords and financial credentials.
My ex-partner or employer planted spyware on my phone and is blackmailing me with private photos and chat transcripts.
My phone battery drains very quickly and an unknown background app is recording my audio conversations and sending them to an external server.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Penalizes unauthorized access, extraction, downloading, or introduction of computer contaminants without consent.
Punishes intentional capturing, publishing, or transmitting images of private areas or violating privacy without consent.

kbc_lottery_whatsapp_prize_scam.display_name: KBC / Fake WhatsApp Lottery and Prize Scam
kbc_lottery_whatsapp_prize_scam.issue_definition: Deceptive lottery notifications circulated on messaging apps claiming high-value lottery wins and demanding advance tax or processing fees.
prototype_texts: I received a WhatsApp voice recording and fake certificate saying my SIM won 25 Lakh in a Kaun Banega Crorepati lucky draw.
Someone posing as a lottery officer asked me to pay 25000 rupees as GST and processing fee to claim a national lucky draw prize.
I was duped into transferring advance bank charges to release a foreign lottery cheque that never arrived.
Fraudsters sent me a WhatsApp banner with photos of Amitabh Bachchan and government logos claiming I won a cash jackpot.
I was sent a WhatsApp message saying I won 25 lakh in KBC lottery and must pay 25000 GST processing fee.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies where fraudsters impersonated television lottery officers using communication devices to cheat the victim.
Prohibits promoting or inducing participation in fraudulent prize schemes and unregulated deposit collection.

fake_crypto_arbitrage_telegram_ponzi.display_name: Fake Crypto Arbitrage Bot and Telegram Investment Scam
fake_crypto_arbitrage_telegram_ponzi.issue_definition: Fraudulent online schemes promising guaranteed high monthly returns via automated crypto arbitrage bots and freezing withdrawals under bogus tax demands.
prototype_texts: I invested 2 Lakh rupees in a Telegram automated crypto trading bot promising 50% monthly returns, but they froze my withdrawal.
Fraudsters created a fake Web3 investment dashboard showing huge crypto profits and are now demanding a 30% tax fee to release my balance.
I was added to a VIP crypto arbitrage group on Telegram where admins induced me to buy USDT and transfer it to a fraudulent contract address.
An online crypto staking platform shut down abruptly after collecting funds from hundreds of investors through UPI and Binance transfers.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Strictly prohibits soliciting, promoting, or accepting unregulated deposits and running fraudulent Ponzi schemes.
Penalizes cheating and financial fraud committed through electronic communication devices and deceptive portals.

health_insurance_claim_arbitrary_rejecti.issue_definition: Repudiation or arbitrary deductions of valid cashless or reimbursement medical claims by health insurers or TPAs without statutory justification.
prototype_texts: The health insurance company rejected my cashless hospitalisation claim citing non-disclosure of pre-existing disease even though my policy is over 5 years old.
TPA repudiated my medical surgery reimbursement claim on flimsy procedural grounds despite full doctor certification.
Insurance company deducted 70% of my hospital bill under arbitrary non-medical expenses without providing statutory justification.
My mediclaim was rejected saying hospitalisation was unnecessary even though the treating physician mandated emergency ICU admission.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Arbitrary repudiation of a valid insurance claim constitutes deficiency in service under the Consumer Protection Act.
Imposing unilateral, unfair exclusions not communicated at policy inception constitutes an unfair trade practice.

misleading_endorser_influencer_financial.display_name: Misleading Influencer and Celebrity Financial Endorsement
misleading_endorser_influencer_financial.issue_definition: Deceptive promotional campaigns by influencers or celebrities endorsing unregulated trading platforms or health products without required risk disclosures.
prototype_texts: A social media influencer promoted an unregulated trading app claiming guaranteed daily returns without disclosing paid sponsorship.
A celebrity endorsed a healthcare supplement falsely claiming it cures diabetes within 30 days without clinical proof.
A finfluencer promoted a deceptive crypto trading scheme without statutory risk disclosures, causing me to lose my savings.
An online brand published fake testimonial videos and deceptive celebrity endorsements to mislead consumers into buying defective products.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Empowers CCPA to impose penalties up to ten lakh rupees on endorsers and manufacturers for false or misleading advertisements.
Imposes criminal liability and fines up to ten lakh rupees on manufacturers and service providers publishing false advertisements prejudicial to consumer interest.

spurious_cosmetics_counterfeit_perfumes.display_name: Sale of Spurious Cosmetics and Hazardous Counterfeit Goods
spurious_cosmetics_counterfeit_perfumes.issue_definition: Supply or sale of counterfeit, adulterated, or hazardous cosmetics and consumer goods lacking statutory batch numbers, BIS markings, or safety labels.
prototype_texts: An e-commerce seller delivered duplicate, counterfeit face cream with toxic chemicals that caused severe skin burning and allergies.
I purchased branded luxury perfume online which turned out to be a cheap chemical fake with no batch number or manufacturing details.
A store sold me adulterated hair serum in original brand packaging, causing acute hair loss and dermatological damage.
The skincare product delivered has a fake ISI mark and no mandatory ingredients list or manufacturer address on the label.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Punishes manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing spurious goods, providing imprisonment and fines where harm is caused.
Holds the product manufacturer strictly liable for harm caused by manufacturing defects, non-conformity to express warranty, or failure to contain adequate warnings.

airline_denied_boarding_overbooking_comp.display_name: Airlines Denied Boarding and Overbooking Compensation Dispute
airline_denied_boarding_overbooking_comp.issue_definition: Involuntary denial of boarding to confirmed ticket holders due to commercial airline overbooking, accompanied by denial of statutory DGCA passenger compensation.
prototype_texts: The airline overbooked the flight and denied me boarding at the airport despite my having a confirmed ticket and reporting on time.
I was forcibly offloaded from my domestic flight because the flight was over capacity, and the airline refused to pay statutory DGCA compensation.
The carrier bumped me to a next-day flight without providing hotel accommodation, food vouchers, or the mandatory 400% compensation.
Airlines staff arbitrarily cancelled my confirmed boarding pass at the boarding gate citing operational overbooking without my consent.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Denying boarding to a passenger holding a confirmed ticket without complying with statutory passenger rights is a clear deficiency in service.
Systematic overbooking and refusing mandatory DGCA CAR denied-boarding compensation constitutes an unfair trade practice.

educational_course_bait_and_switch_place.display_name: Ed-Tech Deceptive Course and False 100% Placement Guarantee
educational_course_bait_and_switch_place.issue_definition: Unfair trade practice where an educational technology provider uses deceptive 100% job placement assurances to induce course enrollment and refuses fee refunds.
prototype_texts: An ed-tech institute promised 100% guaranteed job placement with minimum 8 LPA package, but provided zero interview calls after taking 1.5 Lakh.
A coding bootcamp used deceptive marketing claiming corporate hiring partnerships with top MNCs which turned out completely fabricated.
The coaching institute advertised experienced faculty from IIT/IIM but assigned unrecorded substandard video lectures by freshers.
I enrolled in a data science course based on an assured placement warranty, but they refused to refund my course fee when no interviews were arranged.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Misleading advertisements conveying false guarantees of placement constitute actionable deception under the Consumer Protection Act.
Imposes criminal punishment and fines on service providers making false or misleading advertisements prejudicial to consumer interest.

two_wheeler_pillion_helmet_challan_dispu.display_name: Two-Wheeler Pillion Helmet and ISI Mark Fine Dispute
two_wheeler_pillion_helmet_challan_dispu.issue_definition: Wrongful challans issued for alleged lack of protective headgear despite compliant BIS/ISI helmets being worn, or violation of statutory turban exemptions.
prototype_texts: Traffic police issued an automated camera challan for pillion without helmet even though the pillion was wearing a full-face helmet clearly visible in the photo.
A police officer fined me 1000 rupees claiming my helmet did not have an ISI sticker even though it is a certified ISI approved helmet.
Traffic police issued a Section 129 challan against a Sikh rider wearing a turban in violation of the statutory exemption.
An e-challan was generated showing a blurry black-and-white camera image where helmet strap shadow was mistaken for non-wearing of headgear.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates wearing protective headgear conforming to BIS standards, while explicitly granting statutory exemption to Sikhs wearing a turban.
Governs the penalty for failure to wear protective headgear, limiting arbitrary enforcement.

good_samaritan_harassment_accident_scene.display_name: Good Samaritan Harassment at Road Accident Scene
good_samaritan_harassment_accident_scene.issue_definition: Unlawful detention, coercion, or witness harassment of citizens rendering emergency assistance to road accident victims, in violation of Supreme Court and statutory guidelines.
prototype_texts: I rushed an injured road accident victim to the hospital, but police and hospital staff detained me and demanded I pay admission charges.
Police are harassing me and repeatedly calling me to the police station for interrogation simply because I helped an accident victim.
A hospital refused to admit an injured pedestrian unless I signed as a guarantor and deposited cash, in violation of Good Samaritan rules.
Enforcement personnel threatened to seize my vehicle because I carried an injured biker to the nearest trauma centre.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates immediate medical attention for accident victims and legally obligates doctors and hospitals to render treatment without procedural formalities.
Restricts arbitrary vehicle seizure by police when no statutory violation of permit or registration exists.

traffic_signal_camera_red_light_yellow_l.display_name: Traffic Signal Camera Red Light vs Amber Light Glitch Dispute
traffic_signal_camera_red_light_yellow_l.issue_definition: Erroneous automated camera challans generated for jumping red lights under Section 184 when the vehicle entered the stop line lawfully on amber or under manual direction.
prototype_texts: I received a 5000 rupee challan under Section 184 for red light jumping, but the camera snapshot proves I crossed the stop line on amber/yellow.
An automated traffic camera issued a red light violation when a traffic policeman was manually directing traffic forward against the signal.
The camera captured a false red light jump because the signal timer malfunctioned and switched from green directly to red without yellow transition.
I had to enter the intersection to give immediate passage to an emergency ambulance, but the automated system generated a heavy dangerous driving fine.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Defines driving dangerously and jumping red lights, which requires taking into account all circumstances including emergency movement and manual direction.
Provides summary procedure before the court for challenging disputed motor vehicle infractions.

commercial_auto_taxi_permit_harassment.display_name: Commercial Auto / Taxi Permit Harassment Dispute
commercial_auto_taxi_permit_harassment.issue_definition: Arbitrary vehicle seizure or extortionate fines imposed on commercial auto and cab operators despite possessing valid national or contract carriage permits.
prototype_texts: Traffic police or RTO flying squad seized my commercial cab claiming permit violation under Section 192A despite valid all-India tourist permit.
An enforcement officer demanded 10000 rupees bribe threatening to impound my commercial auto for operating slightly outside municipal limits.
Police seized my vehicle keys and issued a challan for 'no permit' because the renewed digital permit was not yet printed in physical copy.
RTO authorities impounded my transport vehicle arbitrarily without issuing a statutory seizure memo or specifying permit contravention.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Governs penalties for using a vehicle without permit and establishes strict parameters for permit non-compliance.
Regulates the statutory power to detain vehicles, mandating an official seizure receipt and prompt release upon compounding.

uninsured_vehicle_challan_portal_sync_de.display_name: Uninsured Vehicle Challan Due to Vahan Portal Sync Delay
uninsured_vehicle_challan_portal_sync_de.issue_definition: Traffic penalties issued under Section 196 for lack of third-party insurance when the policy was actively renewed but had not yet synced to the central Vahan database.
prototype_texts: Traffic police issued a 2000 rupee challan under Section 196 for 'no insurance' even though I renewed my policy 24 hours earlier.
An automated camera captured my car and generated a fine for expired insurance because the insurance company had not uploaded data to IIB/Vahan.
A police officer refused to accept my valid insurance policy PDF on my phone and impounded my RC alleging driving an uninsured vehicle.
I was fined for driving an uninsured vehicle despite showing the active policy schedule with valid policy number and premium receipt.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Penalizes driving an uninsured vehicle, which cannot be sustained when an active valid insurance contract exists at the time of the alleged offence.
Mandates production of certificates of insurance and allows production within statutory timeframe.

statutory_bonus_denial_profitable_establ.display_name: Denial of Statutory Annual Minimum Bonus
statutory_bonus_denial_profitable_establ.issue_definition: Unlawful withholding of the statutory 8.33% annual minimum bonus from eligible workers by commercial or industrial employers.
prototype_texts: My employer refused to pay the statutory 8.33% annual bonus claiming the company did not make enough profit this year.
The management withheld Diwali bonus from all factory workers even though we completed over 200 days of work in the accounting year.
The company pays basic salary below 21000 but denies annual bonus to contract and permanent staff in violation of the Code on Wages.
Our employer cancelled annual bonus disbursements citing business expansion expenses without any statutory exemption.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Guarantees every employee who has worked at least thirty days an annual minimum bonus of 8.33% irrespective of whether the employer has allocable surplus.
Empowers statutory authorities to hear and determine claims arising from non-payment of bonus and wages.

pf_uan_mismatch_employer_refusal_to_atte.display_name: Employer Refusal to Attest EPFO Joint Declaration Form
pf_uan_mismatch_employer_refusal_to_atte.issue_definition: Malicious refusal or delay by an employer to approve digital EPFO joint declarations for employee name, DOB, or father's name correction, blocking retirement withdrawals.
prototype_texts: My ex-employer is maliciously refusing to sign and approve my EPFO joint declaration form to correct my name and date of birth.
The company is blocking my PF withdrawal by refusing to approve the digital joint declaration request on the EPFO unified employer portal.
The establishment closed down or HR is demanding I withdraw my wage complaint before they sign my PF correction documents.
My provident fund transfer is rejected because employer entered the wrong father's name and now refuses to upload supporting KYC.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Regulates permissible wage deductions and employer duties regarding employee provident fund remittances.
Authorizes Inspector-cum-Facilitators to inspect establishment records and compel employer compliance with statutory obligations.

unpaid_intern_full_workload_exploitation.display_name: Exploitative Unpaid Internship Disguised as Regular Employment
unpaid_intern_full_workload_exploitation.issue_definition: Extracting full-time commercial labour and client deliverables from fresh graduates under the guise of an 'unpaid internship' while denying statutory minimum wages.
prototype_texts: A company hired me as an 'unpaid intern' but forces me to work 50 hours a week doing core software development without any stipend.
I was promised a learning internship, but they assigned me full client deliverables and threaten to withhold my certificate if I demand wages.
The firm uses 20 college graduates as unpaid trainees to handle regular business operations without paying statutory minimum wages.
I worked 6 months as an unpaid trainee generating direct company revenue, but they fired me without certificate or compensation.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Mandates that no employer shall pay less than the statutory minimum rate of wages to any person employed in an establishment.
Defines normal working hours and mandates statutory rest intervals, preventing exploitative full-time unpaid labour.

non_provision_of_statutory_payslips_reco.display_name: Non-Provision of Statutory Wage Slips and Wage Concealment
non_provision_of_statutory_payslips_reco.issue_definition: Willful failure by an employer to maintain statutory muster rolls or issue written wage slips detailing gross pay, deductions, and overtime to workers.
prototype_texts: My employer pays my salary in lump sum cash without ever issuing a wage slip or explaining deductions.
The management refuses to provide written salary slips, preventing workers from seeing PF, ESI, or overtime calculations.
The company maintains a hidden duplicate muster roll and denies employees official wage documentation.
Our employer fires workers who ask for monthly payslips and refuses to provide proof of income required for bank loans.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Explicitly mandates every employer to maintain statutory registers of wages and muster rolls and to issue wage slips to all employees.
Empowers Inspector-cum-Facilitators to inspect establishment records and enforce compliance with record-keeping rules.
