floor_wage_violation_remote_gig_contract.display_name: Sub-Floor Wage Exploitation of Remote Gig Workers
floor_wage_violation_remote_gig_contract.issue_definition: Platform or staffing agencies paying piece-rate or task-based workers less than the statutory national floor wage fixed by the Central Government.
prototype_texts: A platform company pays remote data entry workers less than 200 rupees for 10 hours of work, below the statutory national floor wage.
An outsourcing agency hires online content moderators at predatory rates that fall far below the central government floor wage.
A gig platform arbitrarily slashes per-task payouts so drastically that net daily earnings violate statutory wage standards.
Remote telecallers working full time are denied baseline statutory floor wages under the pretext of 'independent contractor' status.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Empowers the Central Government to fix the national floor wage and prohibits any employer or state from paying wages below this statutory baseline.
Mandates that minimum wage rates fixed by government cannot fall below the notified floor wage.

unreasonable_restraint_on_legal_remedies.display_name: Unlawful Contractual Restraint on Legal Proceedings
unreasonable_restraint_on_legal_remedies.issue_definition: Contractual clauses that attempt to completely bar a party from approaching ordinary courts or arbitrarily extinguish legal rights within unreasonably shortened timeframes.
prototype_texts: My service provider contract has a clause stating that neither party can ever approach a court of law or consumer forum for any dispute.
A company agreement states that any dispute must be filed within 7 days or all legal rights are permanently extinguished.
The vendor agreement contains an illegal clause barring me from exercising statutory legal remedies under Indian law.
A commercial contractor claims I cannot sue them because the contract says 'parties waive all rights to initiate legal action'.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Explicitly declares that any agreement restricting a party absolutely from enforcing contractual rights in ordinary tribunals or shortening limitation periods is void to that extent.
Renders void any agreement whose object or consideration is unlawful or opposed to public policy.

undue_influence_senior_citizen_property_.display_name: Undue Influence and Unconscionable Agreement with Vulnerable Person
undue_influence_senior_citizen_property_.issue_definition: Agreements procured by dominating the will of an elderly, ill, or distressed person through fiduciary trust or authority to obtain unfair commercial advantage.
prototype_texts: A tenant took unfair advantage of an elderly landlord's illness and isolation to execute an unconscionable 20-year lease at token rent.
A caregiver coerced an ailing senior citizen into signing a gift deed or property transfer agreement under mental distress.
A business associate used a fiduciary relationship of trust to induce a vulnerable partner into signing away their entire company equity.
An agreement was executed when the signatory was admitted in the hospital ICU under heavy medication and unable to exercise free will.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Defines undue influence where a person in a position of dominance or fiduciary relationship uses it to obtain an unfair advantage over a vulnerable person.
Provides that contracts caused by coercion, fraud, or misrepresentation are voidable at the option of the aggrieved party.

fraudulent_active_concealment_used_car_s.display_name: Fraudulent Active Concealment in Vehicle or Asset Sale
fraudulent_active_concealment_used_car_s.issue_definition: Deliberate active concealment of material structural damage, flood immersion, odometer rollback, or financial encumbrances to induce an asset purchase contract.
prototype_texts: A used car dealer actively concealed that the vehicle had met with a total-loss accident and had flood engine damage before selling it to me.
The seller fraudulently rolled back the odometer by 80,000 kilometres and concealed structural chassis welding in the sale agreement.
A seller deliberately hid a major bank hypothecation and outstanding loan lien on machinery sold under a 'free from encumbrances' clause.
The vendor actively covered up termite infestation and structural wall cracks in a commercial property sale agreement using fresh plaster.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Explicitly defines fraud as active concealment of a fact by one having knowledge of it, or making false suggestions with intent to deceive.
Makes the contract voidable at the option of the defrauded party, entitling them to cancel the contract and seek restitution.

indemnity_refusal_vendor_third_party_tax.display_name: Vendor Refusal to Honour Contractual Indemnity Clause
indemnity_refusal_vendor_third_party_tax.issue_definition: Willful refusal by a commercial vendor or contractor to defend and hold harmless their client against third-party claims or statutory tax attachments despite an express indemnity clause.
prototype_texts: A software vendor refused to indemnify our company when a third party sued us for software copyright infringement caused by their code.
A contractor failed to pay GST and tax authorities issued a recovery attachment on our accounts, but the vendor refuses to honour the indemnity clause.
A logistics vendor refused to compensate us for third-party cargo damages despite an express indemnity clause in the master service agreement.
A facility management vendor refused to defend us against labour penalty claims arising from their non-compliance with statutory wages.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Defines a contract of indemnity where the promisor promises to save the promisee from loss caused by the promisor's conduct or third parties.
Enables the aggrieved party to recover all direct losses naturally arising in the usual course of things from the breach of contract.

unilateral_cancellation_of_commercial_le.display_name: Unilateral Commercial Lease Cancellation Before Handover
unilateral_cancellation_of_commercial_le.issue_definition: Unilateral termination or anticipatory breach of an executed commercial lease or agreement to lease by a property developer before handing over physical possession.
prototype_texts: A mall developer accepted my 10 Lakh advance deposit and signed a commercial lease agreement, but cancelled unilaterally before handover to lease to a higher bidder.
The commercial property owner signed an agreement to lease for our retail outlet, but refused to hand over keys and forfeited our advance.
After we spent 5 Lakh on architectural drawings and store planning, the landlord backed out of the signed commercial lease without cause.
A commercial landlord breached the signed letter of intent and lease deed by unilaterally terminating before the agreed fit-out period.

provision_references.provision_relevance_rationale: Applies where a party has refused to perform their promise in its entirety, entitling the other party to put an end to the contract.
Mandates compensation for direct loss and damages suffered due to breach of contract, including wasted fit-out expenses and lost profits.
